episodesList.title: Icchapyari Ki Iccha
episodesList.summary: Meet Ichha, a charming and cheerful snake, who stays with her community in Naagistan. Iccha is on a mission to befriend humans and change their perception about snakes.

episodesList.title: Iccha Meets Babbal
episodesList.summary: Iccha brings unconscious Babbal to his house. Dadi and her family members assume Iccha to be a robber.

episodesList.title: Chirmiri Meets Iccha
episodesList.summary: Kaushalya allows Iccha to stay in her house. Chirmiri tells her father that Iccha should stay away from humans. Chirmiri’s father instructs her to not cause any harm to Iccha.

episodesList.title: Kaushalya Locks Iccha In a Room
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells Ballu that he has a lot of misconceptions about snakes. Ballu apologizes for his mistake. Kaushalya and her family yell at Iccha for meeting their enemies.

episodesList.title: Iccha Ka Secret
episodesList.summary: Appu watches Iccha in her snake form. He tells Kaushalya that Iccha is actually a snake and not a girl. Kaushalya refuses to believe the truth.

episodesList.title: Appu Ki Wish
episodesList.summary: Mamata tells Iccha that Appu has always cherished a dream of flying a helicopter. Iccha meets Ramnivas and requests him to fulfil Appu’s wish.

episodesList.title: Appu Apologizes to Iccha
episodesList.summary: Appu tells Iccha that he had brought Mongoose to the house. He apologizes to Iccha for causing her trouble. Iccha shares her family details with Appu.

episodesList.title: Iccha Decides to Reveal Her Secret
episodesList.summary: Iccha’s father turn Khadak and Chanchal into frogs. Iccha decides to reveal her secret to Kaushalya’s family.

episodesList.title: Ichha's Parents
episodesList.summary: Kaushalya’s family meet a couple who claims to be Iccha’s parents. The couple bring Iccha to a jungle. Will Iccha be able to save herself from her fake parents?

episodesList.title: Iccha Stops Kaushalya From Hurting The Snakes
episodesList.summary: Kaushalya and her family is terrified to see snakes in the house. Kaushalya asks her sons to kill the snake at the earliest. Iccha requests all to not hurt the snake.

episodesList.title: Iccha Ka Dost
episodesList.summary: Supda meets his family and friends. He learns that they have sent Iccha to earth to change the perception of humans about snakes. Supda decides to rescue Iccha from earth.

episodesList.title: Nagina Blames Iccha
episodesList.summary: Iccha serves tea to Kaushalya’s family. Nagina blames Iccha for trying to kill her by adding poison in her cup of tea.

episodesList.title: Supda Ka Challenge
episodesList.summary: Supda tells his family that Iccha won’t succeed in changing the perception about snakes. Babbal’s family decide to find an alliance for him.

episodesList.title: Appu Faints
episodesList.summary: Babbal’s family find an alliance for him. Appu faints as he touches Iccha’s hands. Iccha requests Supda to save Appu’s life.

episodesList.title: Episode 15
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells Supda that she is going to reveal her real identity to Kaushalya’s family. On the other hand, Kaushalya Devi and her family notice a snake in their house.

episodesList.title: Episode 16
episodesList.summary: Appu advises Iccha to not reveal her real identity to his family. Appu tells his mother that he doesn’t wish to attend school on the next day. He later requests Iccha to convince his father to not force him to go to school.

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: A snake threatens to kill Shankar. Appu tells Iccha that he is not going to school for a day.

episodesList.title: Episode 18
episodesList.summary: Iccha and Babbal come to a bank to take out Kaushalya's jewellery from the locker. A few goons intrude into the bank for robbery.

episodesList.title: Episode 19
episodesList.summary: Bank robbers lock Iccha and Babbal in a room. Babbal tells Iccha that she should not have risked her life to defend him from his attackers.

episodesList.title: Episode 20
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells Kausalya that a snake might have bitten her husband for self defence. Iccha tells Appu that they must share Binnu's truth with his family members.

episodesList.title: Episode 21
episodesList.summary: Kausalya tries to kill a snake, but Iccha cleverly saves the life of the snake. Iccha requests Babbal to not have hatred towards snakes.

episodesList.title: Episode 22
episodesList.summary: Deva comes to Kausalya's house. Iccha tells Appu that Deva is infamous for killing snakes. Kausalya asks Iccha to take the blessings of Deva.

episodesList.title: Episode 23
episodesList.summary: Babbal asks Deva to not insult Iccha. Deva informs Siddhu that they can find a treasure in Kausalya's house. Iccha secretly listens to Deva and Siddhu's conversation.

episodesList.title: Episode 24
episodesList.summary: Iccha appears before Deva in her real avatar. She challenges Deva for a competition. Iccha tells Appu that they must reveal Deva's secret before Kausalya.

episodesList.title: Episode 25
episodesList.summary: Iccha saves Appu from Deva and his aides. Police comes to Kausalya's house and arrest Deva. Kausalya's family thanks Iccha for saving Appu's life.

episodesList.title: Episode 26
episodesList.summary: Kausalya tells Iccha that soon she is going to arrange her marriage. Iccha tells Babbal that she doesn't wish to get married. Will Kausalya respect Iccha's decision?

episodesList.title: Episode 27
episodesList.summary: Kausalya and her family plan to arrange Iccha's marriage. Kausalya invites two boys to her house. She tells Iccha that she must choose one of them as her husband.

episodesList.title: Episode 28
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells Babbal that she wishes to marry Ajay. Babbal advises Iccha to not act in haste. Iccha clears it to Kausalya's family that she is determined to marry Ajay.

episodesList.title: Episode 29
episodesList.summary: Nagina tells Prem that she doesn't want Iccha to stay in her house. She asks Prem to throw Iccha out of her house in the night. Nagina adds sleeping pills to the milk and offers it to all her family members.

episodesList.title: Episode 30
episodesList.summary: Prem and Nagina plan to kidnap Iccha. However, Kausalya's family stop them from abducting Iccha. Iccha thanks Kausalya's family for saving her from Prem's clutches.

episodesList.title: Episode 31
episodesList.summary: Appu's school teacher scolds him for believing in superstitions. Iccha tells Appu that she will convince his school teacher that wishful snakes do exist.

episodesList.title: Episode 32
episodesList.summary: Iccha meets Appu's school teacher and informs her that she is a wishful snakes. Appu's Principal scolds him for spreading superstitions in the school.

episodesList.title: Episode 33
episodesList.summary: Appu tells Iccha that the principal is planning to rusticate him from the school. Prabal and Mamata come to Appu’s school to meet his principal.

episodesList.title: Episode 34
episodesList.summary: Principal appologizes to Iccha for scolding Appu. Iccha tells Appu that his school teacher and Principal are standing in front of his house.

episodesList.title: Episode 35
episodesList.summary: Appu tells his principal that he can show him a magic trick. A thief intrudes into the house and demands money from the principal. A snake prevents thief from stealing the cash from the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 36
episodesList.summary: Babbal tells Kausalya Devi that he wishes to bring a Mongoose to his house. Appu requests Babbal to reconsider his decision. Iccha comes to Naagistan to meet her parents.

episodesList.title: Episode 37
episodesList.summary: Iccha's sister comes to Babbal's house in the guise of Iccha. She plans to punish Babbal's family for their past mistakes. Babbal brings a mongoose to his house.

episodesList.title: Episode 38
episodesList.summary: Babbal brings the mongoose to the hall. He invites Chirmiri to see the mongoose. Babbal gets shocked to see when the mongoose starts attacking Chirmiri.

episodesList.title: Episode 39
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells Appu that they must avoid firecrackers during Diwali festival. Kausalya’s family gather to celebrate Diwali.

episodesList.title: Episode 40
episodesList.summary: Babbal's family admit him to a hospital. Pyarelal meets Kausalya and her family. He advises them to donate Babbal's organs to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Episode 41
episodesList.summary: Iccha prays to god to save Babbal's life. The doctor informs Kausalya's family that Babbal has passed away.

episodesList.title: Episode 42
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells her family that she loves Babbal and his family. Iccha requests her parents to let her share her soul with Babbal.

episodesList.title: Episode 43
episodesList.summary: Iccha restores Babbal to life with the help of her magical powers. Babbal's family get shocked to see him alive.

episodesList.title: Episode 44
episodesList.summary: Kausalya asks Babbal to call a doctor to her house. A doctor comes to Babbal's house to treat Iccha. He tells Babbal that he is not able to diagnose the disease.

episodesList.title: Episode 45
episodesList.summary: Kausalya welcomes Babbal and Iccha to her house. Waku tells Iccha that she should not risk her life for others.

episodesList.title: Episode 46
episodesList.summary: Amruta agrees to stay in Kausalya’s house. Iccha learns that Amruta wishes to make a movie on the lives of wrestlers.

episodesList.title: Episode 47
episodesList.summary: Babbal realizes that he has fallen for Iccha. A police comes to Kausalya's house to arrest one of her sons. Amruta plans to kill Kausalya's family.

episodesList.title: Episode 48
episodesList.summary: Kausalya tells her family that they must find out the culprit who had kept a bomb in their house. Iccha decides to catch the person responsible for the crime.

episodesList.title: Episode 49
episodesList.summary: Vaishali secretly enters a police station.  A goon informs Vaishali that a snake had forced him to apologize to Kausalaya.

episodesList.title: Episode 50
episodesList.summary: Kausalya tells Iccha that Mamata has gone missing. Mamata meets Prabal's uncle and tells him that she is not a snake.

episodesList.title: Episode 51
episodesList.summary: Kausalya informs the police that Mamata has gone missing from her house. Appu requests Iccha to find out his mother at the earliest.

episodesList.title: Episode 52
episodesList.summary: Kausalya invites a lawyer to her house. She requests the lawyer to get Babbal out from jail. Vishaili threatens Mamata to reveal her true identity. Mamata clears it to Vishaili that she is not a snake.

episodesList.title: Episode 53
episodesList.summary: Kausalya and her family learn that Mamata has lost her memory. On the other hand, Vishali plans to give 'naagmani' to Iccha.

episodesList.title: Episode 54
episodesList.summary: A snake meets Iccha and requests him to take the 'naagmani' to Naagistan. Mamata tells her family that she wishes to leave the house as she has lost her memory.

episodesList.title: Episode 55
episodesList.summary: Kausalya advises Iccha to convince Mamata to get married. Iccha and Babbal come to Mamata's room. Mamata clears it to them that she doesn't wish to marry Prabal.

episodesList.title: Episode 56
episodesList.summary: Waku teases Mamata in the guise of a goon. Prabal comes to Mamata's rescue and saves her from the goon. Mamata tells her family that she is willing to marry Prabal. Iccha notices a scar on Amruta's body.

episodesList.title: Episode 57
episodesList.summary: Buddhiraj tells Vishaili that he will punish Waku for saving Iccha's life. Kausalya's family gather for Mamata's sangeet ceremony.

episodesList.title: Episode 58
episodesList.summary: Waku meets Babbal in the guise of Iccha. Buddhiraj tells Vishaili that he will soon attack Iccha with his powers.

episodesList.title: Episode 59
episodesList.summary: Babbal starts applying Mehendi on Amruta's hands. Amruta spots Iccha's look-alike in the sangeet ceremony. Iccha tells Waku that they must fight against the evil force.

episodesList.title: Episode 60
episodesList.summary: Buddhiraj attacks Iccha with his powers. Iccha and Waku hit back at Buddhiraj. Vishaili meets Iccha in the guise of an old woman. Later, Iccha learns that Babbal is attracted towards Amruta.

episodesList.title: Episode 61
episodesList.summary: Iccha challenges Buddhiraj to fight against Prabal. Kausalya's family gather for Prabal and Mamata's marriage. Buddhiraj attacks Prabal with his powers.

episodesList.title: Episode 62
episodesList.summary: Prabal requests Buddhiraj to help him regain Mamata's memory. On the other hand, Mamata tells her family that she doesn't wish to marry Prabal.

episodesList.title: Episode 63
episodesList.summary: Iccha's family congratulate her for saving Naagistan from Buddhiraj. Vishaili plans to take the help of Aagvansh to beat Iccha.

episodesList.title: Episode 64
episodesList.summary: Vishaili tells Aagvansh that he should not have hurt Babbal. Aagvansh apologizes to Vishaili for his mistake. Kausalya assures Iccha that they would soon get rid of all their family problems.

episodesList.title: Episode 65
episodesList.summary: Vishaili asks Aagvansh to attack Kausalya's family. Kausalya asks Mamata to prepare a sweet dish for all the family members.

episodesList.title: Episode 66
episodesList.summary: Prabal plans to go on honeymoon with Mamata. Later, Mamata informs Iccha that she is going to light a lantern in the house. Vishaili plans to attack Kausalya's family with the help of a few rats.

episodesList.title: Episode 67
episodesList.summary: Iccha’s parents come to Kausalya’s house. Iccha tells her father that she suspects Amruta to be Vishaili.

episodesList.title: Episode 68
episodesList.summary: Waku tells Iccha that her mother Sipli will perform 'hawan' in the guise of Kausalya. Sipli gets burnt while performing 'hawan'.

episodesList.title: Episode 69
episodesList.summary: Iccha meets Vishaili in the guise of Aagwansh. She finds out that Vishaili is planning to harm Kausalya's family.

episodesList.title: Episode 70
episodesList.summary: Vishaili, in the guise of Amruta, tells Iccha that Aagwansh has saved her from the snakes of Naagistan. Iccha asks Vishaili to not cause any harm to Kausalya's family.

episodesList.title: Episode 72
episodesList.summary: Kausalya advises Babbal to marry Amruta. Babbal clears it to his family that he doesn't wish to get married. Iccha asks Waku to find out Aagwansh's background.

episodesList.title: Episode 73
episodesList.summary: Babbal angrily tells Iccha that he doesn't like her. Babbal informs his family that he is ready to marry Amruta.

episodesList.title: Episode 74
episodesList.summary: Vishaili adds poison in a glass of milk. She plans to offer the glass to Babbal. Will Iccha be able to save Babbal from Vishaili’s evil plan?

episodesList.title: Episode 75
episodesList.summary: Iccha informs Amruta that she has punished Aagwansh for his mistakes. She further advises Amruta to not marry Babbal.

episodesList.title: Episode 76
episodesList.summary: Babbal informs Kausalya that he is determined to marry Amruta. Babbal's family gather for his engagement ceremony. Babbal asks Iccha to perform dance in front of his family.

episodesList.title: Episode 77
episodesList.summary: Babbal and Amruta get engaged to each other. Vishaili informs her sister that she is going to turn Babbal into a snake. Babbal angrily asks Iccha to not interfere in her personal life.

episodesList.title: Episode 78
episodesList.summary: Prabal advises Babbal to not marry Amruta. Babbal starts fighting against his brother in front of his family.

episodesList.title: Episode 79
episodesList.summary: Prabal advises Babbal to not marry Amruta. Babbal starts fighting against his brother in front of his family.

episodesList.title: Episode 80
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells Waku that they must stop Vishaili from turning Babbal into a snake. Iccha's mother asks her to free Babbal from Vishaili's clutches. Vishaili informs Iccha that soon Babbal would turn into a snake.

episodesList.title: Episode 81
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells her parents that she would soon prove her innocence to Kausalya's family. Iccha informs Babbal that she loves him a lot.

episodesList.title: Episode 82
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells her mother that Amruta can not marry Babbal unless she turns him into a snake. Babbal asks Iccha to perform dance in his wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 83
episodesList.summary: Kausalya's family plans to have Babbal and Amruta's wedding within two days. Iccha tells Appu that they must not allow Vishaili to marry Babbal. Vishaili invites her mother to Babbal's house.

episodesList.title: Episode 84
episodesList.summary: Vishali promises her sister that she would soon turn Babbal into a snake. Iccha tells her mother that Vishaili has hypnotized Amruta.

episodesList.title: Episode 85
episodesList.summary: Iccha requests Babbal to not marry Amruta. Pandit tells Iccha that a gemstone can turn Vishaili into her original form.

episodesList.title: Episode 86
episodesList.summary: Babbal's brothers advise him to marry Iccha. Babbal clears it to his brother that he will marry Amruta and not Iccha. Vishaili finds out that Iccha has intruded into Vishailgarh.

episodesList.title: Episode 87
episodesList.summary: Iccha comes to Vishailgarh and finds a gemstone which can turn Vishaili into a snake. Kausalya's family gather for Babbal and Amruta's marriage.

episodesList.title: Episode 88
episodesList.summary: Mamata tells her family that Vishaili and her aide had kidnapped her. Vishaili attacks Iccha with her evil powers.

episodesList.title: Episode 102

episodesList.title: Episode 111

episodesList.title: Episode 112

episodesList.title: Episode 116

episodesList.title: Episode 118

episodesList.title: Episode 121

episodesList.title: Episode 122

episodesList.title: Episode 123

episodesList.title: Episode 124

episodesList.title: Episode 125

episodesList.title: Episode 126

episodesList.title: Episode 127

episodesList.title: Episode 128
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells her parents that she wishes to stay in Naagistan. Iccha comes to Kausalya’s house. She plans to inform Babbal that she loves him a lot.

episodesList.title: Episode 129
episodesList.summary: Iccha comes to Babbal’s room to give him her love letter. Kausalya informs Iccha that soon Babbal is going to marry Chahat.

episodesList.title: Episode 130

episodesList.title: Episode 131
episodesList.summary: Iccha learns that Vishnaini is planning to invoke Naagshul. Later, Iccha plans to take revenge against Vishnaini.

episodesList.title: Episode 132
episodesList.summary: Vishnaini kidnaps Iccha’s father. Iccha appears before Vishnaini in the guise of Vishpreet. Iccha asks Vishnaini to not cause any harm to her father.

episodesList.title: Episode 133
episodesList.summary: Vishnaini hurls a trident towards Iccha. However, the trident ends up hitting Vishpreet. Vishnaini plans to take revenge against Iccha.

episodesList.title: Episode 134
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells Babbal that she loves him a lot. Iccha’s mother comes to Kausalya’s house. Iccha tells her mother that she wishes to come back to Naagistan.

episodesList.title: Episode 135
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells Babbal that she has decided to move out of Kausalya’s house. Babbal requests Iccha to attend his wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 136
episodesList.summary: Babbal’s family get ready for his marriage ceremony. Vishnaini instructs one of her aides to attack Iccha.

episodesList.title: Episode 137
episodesList.summary: Babbal tells Iccha that he wishes to marry her. Iccha replies Babbal that she can not marry him.

episodesList.title: Episode 138
episodesList.summary: Vishnaini gets killed by her own trident while trying to hit Iccha. Iccha marries to Babbal in front of his family members.

episodesList.title: Episode 139
episodesList.summary: Sursuri tells Iccha’a parents that she doesn’t approve of Iccha’s marriage. Iccha’s father instructs her to perform post-wedding rituals of Naagistan.

episodesList.title: Episode 140
episodesList.summary: Iccha secretly plan to perform a ritual after her wedding. She tells Waku that she wants to pour milk on her in-laws.

episodesList.title: Episode 141
episodesList.summary: Iccha offers milk to Kausalya. Waku meets Babbal in the guise of Iccha. Sursuri comes to Kausalya’s house.

episodesList.title: Episode 142

episodesList.title: Episode 143
episodesList.summary: Mukhiya tells Iccha’s parents that Sursuri is planning to break Iccha’s marriage. Kausalya asks Iccha to prepare a sweet dish for her family.

episodesList.title: Episode 144

episodesList.title: Episode 145
episodesList.summary: Iccha spots a snake in a vase while performing ‘pooja’.She immediately throws the vase out of her house. Kausalya yells at Iccha for her behaviour.

episodesList.title: Episode 146
episodesList.summary: Appu’s teacher comes to Kausalya’s house. He tells Kausalya that Appu has failed in the examination. Kausalya tells Babbal and Iccha that her family is facing a lot of troubles after their marriage.

episodesList.title: Episode 147
episodesList.summary: Iccha requests Sursuri to not interfere in her family affairs. Waku tells Iccha that Sursuri may cause trouble in her family.

episodesList.title: Episode 148
episodesList.summary: Iccha asks Kausalya as to why she disallowed Mamata from making breakfast. Kausalya replies Iccha that she had not given any order to Mamata. Iccha yells at Kausalya and asks her to leave her house.

episodesList.title: Episode 149
episodesList.summary: Kausalya arranges a competition between her daughter-in-laws. Chanchal and Mamata plan to spoil Iccha’s dish by adding excessive salt.

episodesList.title: Episode 150
episodesList.summary: Sursuri tells Iccha that she will force her to leave Kausalya’s house. Waku and Iccha plan to seize Sursuri in a bag.

episodesList.title: Episode 151
episodesList.summary: Kausalya informs her daughter-in-laws that her sister Mithila would soon come to her house. She instructs them to look after her sister.

episodesList.title: Episode 152
episodesList.summary: Kausalya asks Iccha to not cause any harm to Mamata. Kausalya instructs Babbal to lock Iccha in a room.

episodesList.title: Episode 153
episodesList.summary: Sursuri tells Jagiri that Iccha’s family will soon throw her away from their house. Iccha asks Kausalya to declare Chanchal and Mamata as winners for the competition organized in her house.

episodesList.title: Episode 154
episodesList.summary: Babbal tells his brothers that his life is ruined after his marriage. Iccha suspects that Babbal has extramarital affair with a girl.

episodesList.title: Episode 155
episodesList.summary: Iccha finds a lipstick mark on Babbal’s shirt. She questions Babbal about his alleged extramarital affair.

episodesList.title: Episode 156
episodesList.summary: Babbal gets shocked to see Sursuri on his bed. A girl tells Iccha that Babbal has fallen for her. She asks Iccha to get out from Babbal’s house.

episodesList.title: Episode 157

episodesList.title: Episode 158

episodesList.title: Episode 159

episodesList.title: Episode 161

episodesList.title: Episode 162
episodesList.summary: Kausalya invites a snake charmer called Baldev to her house. Baldev plans to catch a snake from Iccha’s house.

episodesList.title: Episode 163
episodesList.summary: Kausalya and her family spot a snake in their house. Later, Babbal tells Iccha that they should end their relationship as he has turned into a snake.

episodesList.title: Episode 164
episodesList.summary: Few goons kidnap Prabal and demand money from his family for his release. Babbal tells Iccha that he has decided to stay away from her as well as his family.

episodesList.title: Episode 165
episodesList.summary: Prabal’s kidnapper calls Kausalya and demands money for Prabal’s release. Iccha plans to rescue Prabal from his kidnappers.

episodesList.title: Episode 166

episodesList.title: Episode 167
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells Kausalya’s family that Babbal has turned into a snake. She also informs them that she is not a human being.

episodesList.title: Episode 168
episodesList.summary: Iccha tells Waku that she wants her family to come to Nagomi Dev’s temple. Iccha drinks Waku’s poison. Babbal agrees to come to the temple along with Iccha.

episodesList.title: Episode 169

episodesList.title: Episode 170
episodesList.summary: Sursuri tells her aides that they must not allow Iccha’s family to perform puja in Naagistan. Iccha and her family successfully perform the puja and return to their house.

episodesList.title: Episode 171
episodesList.summary: Iccha’s Guru tells her that they must kill Babbal as he still remembers the events in Naagistan. Iccha requests her Guru to not kill her husband.

episodesList.title: Episode 172

episodesList.title: Episode 173
episodesList.summary: Waku tells Iccha that she is hypnotized by her Guru. Iccha tells Waku that she will not allow anyone to kill Babbal. Waku replies Iccha that she will be compelled to kill her husband.

episodesList.title: Episode 174

episodesList.title: Episode 175
episodesList.summary: Iccha gets shocked to see her father in Kausalya’s house. Iccha’s father tells her that he wants to kill her husband. Iccha clears it to her father that she would not allow anyone to kill Babbal.

episodesList.title: Episode 176
episodesList.summary: Babbal falls unconscious on the ground after Iccha’s father bites him. Iccha saves Babbal’s life by expelling the poison from his body.

episodesList.title: Episode 177
episodesList.summary: Naaganjana orders her aides to attack Babbal. Iccha plans to save Babbal from Naaganjana. Naaganjana soon learns that Iccha is a snake.

episodesList.title: Episode 178

episodesList.title: Episode 179
episodesList.summary: Babbal informs his family that Iccha has left their house. Waku advises Iccha to not go to the jungle of mongooses.

episodesList.title: Episode 180
episodesList.summary: Waku appears before Babbal in the guise of Iccha. He informs Babbal that Iccha had given life to him in the past. Babbal requests Waku to take him to Iccha.

episodesList.title: Episode 181
episodesList.summary: The snakes of Naagistan plan to kill Babbal. They instruct Babbal to dive into a pool filled with poison. Iccha tells her father that she would die along with her husband.

episodesList.title: Episode 182

episodesList.title: Episode 183

episodesList.title: Episode 185

episodesList.title: Episode 186

Meanwhile, Ichha walks into the room and tries to change Khadak's attitude about shape-shifting snakes but her efforts go in vain. Later, Ichha is stunned when Babbal informs her that he has decided to take Naaganjana to Naagistan.

episodesList.title: Episode 188

As Naaganjana is about to enter the portal to Naagistan, she is trapped in a glass box. Naaganjana realises that Babbal has been cheating her all this while showing his allegiance towards. An infuriated Naaganjana vows to take revenge on Babbal.

episodesList.title: Episode 189
episodesList.summary: Bollywood actor Ritesh Deshmukh, who is playing the role of  Champak, a thief, in his new film Bank Chor, manages to fool the family members. Champak makes them believe that he is a police officer. When the real police officers arrive, the family members believe Champak instead of the real cops.

episodesList.title: Episode 190
episodesList.summary: Babbal and Iccha are against the family's decision of tasking Bhulakkad with Sabal's wedding photography. However, Sabal insists that Bhulakkad will be his wedding photographer. A concerned Iccha and Babbal decides to come up with a solution to spare the blushes of the family during the wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 191
episodesList.summary: Babbal and Iccha are regretting not having thrown the album. Then, Babbal tries to find the album in the house. But, before he can make away with the bag containing the album, Khadak arrives and takes the bag from him.

episodesList.title: Episode 192
episodesList.summary: Babbal and Iccha are shocked to see the album. Dadi forces Babbal to hand over the album to her. Will Iccha's secret be out before Dadi?

episodesList.title: Episode 193
episodesList.summary: Mamta is terrified seeing her husband talking to a snake. The family members are in a state of shock seeing a snake in their house. Later, Dadi brings holy water for Ichha. But,  Babbal drinks the water for her instead.

episodesList.title: Episode 194
episodesList.summary: Dadi wants Ichha to get an injection and recover fast. However, Ichha gets anxious at the sight of the injection and shouts in a man's voice. Dadi gets perturbed with Ichha's manly voice. Then, Ichha refuses to get an injection and runs out of the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 195
episodesList.summary: Waku impersonating himself as Ichha, falls unconscious after a road accident and is brought home. Confusion among family members arise after real Ichha who had gone to the temple with Mamta bhabhi also enters the house. Trying to escape from the chaos, Waku gets himself trapped in a snake-hole. Find out what happened next.

episodesList.title: Episode 196
episodesList.summary: Sheshu appears at the Pratap house where he blames Iccha of treating her brother, Waku work like a slave. However, Iccha and Babbal assure Sheshu that Waku will be treated properly and they will keep a watch over him. Later, Iccha assumes the form of Waku to relieve her brother of the household chores. Find out what happens next!

episodesList.title: Episode 197
episodesList.summary: Waku take out the poison from Mamta in order to save her, however, the poison makes him weak. Iccha asks Waku to take her form, while she visits Nagistan to find out who had beaten Mamta. Find out what happens next!

episodesList.title: Episode 198
episodesList.summary: Ichha tries to help Sabbal woo the woman of his dreams. Sabbal slips into a day dream and sees that he is happily married in the future. But, Sabbal's dreams crashes down before it could take off as the woman is already engaged. Later, Dadi asks Ichha to perform a ritual but Ichha gets startled upon hearing this.

episodesList.title: Episode 199
episodesList.summary: Sur Suri disguises herself as Waku but her disguise fails to fool Iccha as she figures out about her true identity. Iccha persuades Sur Suri to return to the Naglok. Later, Iccha confines Prabal. Babbal asks Iccha to turn into Prabal for a few days so that the family members do not get suspicious. Why has Iccha confined Prabal?

episodesList.title: Episode 200
episodesList.summary: Iccha is caught by Mamta in the store room. In the store room, Mamta hears Prabal's voice. Babbal assures Mamta that Prabal is not in the store room and takes her away. Iccha is worried that their secret will revealed to the family members soon.

episodesList.title: Episode 201
episodesList.summary: Iccha wants to reveal to her family members that she is a shape-shifting snake. But, before she can reveal it, Babbal, intervenes and claims that she is a superwoman. Prabal wants to expose Iccha's secret but Babbal foils his plans.

episodesList.title: Episode 202
episodesList.summary: During the game of truth and dare, Iccha tries to confess her truth but fails to do so. Babbal tells Iccha that before exposing them to her truth, it is important to make them realize how important she is in their lives. He asks Iccha to disappear and take her naagin form and watch as he tells them that Iccha has left the house. However, things go south as Dadi locks up iccha in her almirah by mistake.

episodesList.title: Episode 203
episodesList.summary: Dadi is shocked to find Iccha in an unconscious state. Then, Babbal helps Iccha regain consciousness. Babbal informs Iccha that he cannot live without her. Then, a doctor arrives to check on Iccha. He decides to administer an injection to Iccha. But, he is startled when he fails to find any veins in Iccha's arm.

episodesList.title: Episode 204
episodesList.summary: Dadi discovers, to her dismay, that Iccha is a shape-shifting snake (Icchadhari Naagin). The family members gather as Dadi slaps Iccha for hiding this fact from her. Babbal pleads with Dadi to forgive Iccha. But, Dadi orders that Iccha should leave the house the very moment.

episodesList.title: Episode 205
episodesList.summary: Iccha's family arrives at Babbal's house from Naagistan in order to convince Kaushalya to change her decision about Iccha. However, despite everyone's desire to keep Iccha in the house, Kaushalya remains adamant and even threatens Iccha's family with violence. Just as Iccha and her family were about to leave, a miracle happens, and Lord Shiva appears at doorsteps of the Pratap House!

plotHtml:
Ichhapyaari Naagin is set in a land called "Naagistan", where many Ichhadhaari Naags and Naagins live. They are nice and some hardly get vicious. One day while watching a TV show, they realize that humans have created a negative image in their minds about snakes and decide to come up with a way to change these perceptions about them. While Chirmiri plans to threaten humans, Ichha believes that perhaps, there might be a more peaceful way to go about with this and comes to earth to change their perceptions. She appears in a temple, before a pandit who worships snake deities and he tells her about the Pratap Family; a simple and loving Pehalwaan family. She befriends Appu who knows about her secret but problems arise when she falls in love with Babbal and must hide her true identity from him.
Meanwhile, Chirmiri who's jealous of Ichha attempts to sabotage her mission on various occasions but fails each time. On the other hand, Vishaili, an evil snake of "Vishailgarh", who lost one of her family members because of Daadi's son, Shankar, vows to kill each and every member of his family and has since kidnapped him and held him hostage to find about the whereabouts of his family. During the Diwali celebration, rivals from the neighbourhood place a bomb in the cracker box at the "Pratap House". Appu unknowingly lights the bomb thinking it's a firecracker and it explodes. Babbal saves Appu but gets severely injured and eventually breathes his last. To bring Babbal back to life, Ichha performs a puja called "Sanjhapratyarpan" where she gives half her life to Babbal.
Vishaili finally locates "Pratap House" and arrives as Amrita, a film maker to make a film on Pehelwaans. She claims to know Shankar and Daadi allows her to stay at their place. Vishaili finds out Ichha an Ichhadhaari Naagin is protecting the Pratap family and is determined to find the way to Naagistaan to destroy it as well. She then attacks the family with the help of Budhiraj, a shape shifting bee and then Aagvansh, a shape shifting fiery eagle but Ichha thwarts her every move. Ichha eventually finds out that Vishaili is the Vishailgarh naagin who was trying to destroy the Pehelwaan family then she threatens her that she is going to destroy the Pratap family and take her revenge from the family.
Babbal realizes his love for Ichha and tries professing his love on various occasions but she ignores him as she promised her mother to stay away from him. After many failed attempts, Babbal decides to make Ichha jealous by flirting with Amrita. Amrita falls for Babbal and it creates a rift between Iccha and Babbal. Prabal who can now read women's minds, mistakes Amrita to be in love with Babbal and informs Daadi who plans to get them married. However, Vishnaini, Vishaili 's sister and Queen of Vishailgarh allows this on the condition that Babbal be turned into a snake through a process called Naag-Atmikaran. Ichha interrupts the process causing Babbal to be hypnotised by Vishaili. Vishnaini arrives at Pratap House as Vishaili's mother to make sure everything goes according to their plan. Meanwhile, Ichha enters Vishailgarh and fetches a diamond which causes the Vishailgarh Sisters to take their snake form during Babbal and Vishaili's wedding and they escape soon afterward. Ichha finds out that she was born as a human and the former queen of Vishailgarh turned her into a naagin so Sipili and Sheshu had to save her. Ichha gets permission to marry Babbal and then she confesses her love to him. Ichha and Babbal finally get married after they defeat Vishali and Vishnaini.
Ichha had to defeat Sursuri a naagin who was jealous because Ichha married a human and who was creating trouble between Ichha and Babbal. Babbal eventually finds out that Ichha is a naagin but then eventually accepts her because she has saved his life during the Diwali incident. After the whole family finds out that Ichha is a naagin, Daadi get very furious and decides to kick her out of the house. Chanchal was very mad at Ichha but then Sipili tells her that Ichha saved her son from dying. Just before Ichha was leaving the house, Lord Shiva comes to the house and tells them that Ichha is a good naagin and she just came on Earth to change people's negative perception on snakes. The whole family then accepts Ichha with their perception about snakes being harmful changes and the series ends.
tagline: Ichhapyaari Naagin is set in a land called "Naagistan", where many Ichhadhaari Naags and Naagins live.

title: Ishqbaaaz
summary: Ishqbaaaz (transl. Lovers) (international title: Game of Love) is an Indian romantic drama television series that aired from 27 June 2016 to 15 March 2019 on Star Plus. It initially starred Nakuul Mehta, Surbhi Chandna, Kunal Jaisingh, Shrenu Parikh, Leenesh Mattoo and Mansi Srivastava. In December 2018, the show took a generation leap and aired a new season, Ishqbaaz: Pyaar Ki Ek Dhinchak Kahaani starring Nakuul Mehta and Niti Taylor.
plot:
Kalyani Singh Oberoi, the matriarch of the family has two sons, Tej and Shakti. Tej is married to Jhanvi and they have three children, Omkara, Rudra and Priyanka. Shakti is married to Pinky and has a son, Shivaay, who is the eldest grandson.
This story is about the Oberoi brothers, Shivaay, Omkara and Rudra, friendship and romances.
Shivaay crosses paths with the self righteous Annika, who confronts him for trying to suppress the poor with the misuse money and lineage. To which, Shivaay gives her a bunch of cash. Presuming that he won the conversation, he moves to his car, only to face Annika breaking the glass of his windshield, and returning him the same bunch of cash, earning the nickname "Khidki-tod".
Surprised by the video showing all these incidents, Dadi, Omkara, and Rudra find Annika at the party they had organized for their grandfather's birthday. But Shivaay ignores her there because he has no knowledge about her bloodline or lineage.
Shivaay firmly believes that he has no time for love and hence plans to marry Tia Kapoor as a business deal. Dadi hires Anika as a wedding planner for Shivaay and Tia's upcoming wedding. At first, his relationship with Annika becomes more hostile due to misunderstandings.
After the misunderstandings are cleared, Shivaay starts to understand Annika and they develop feelings for each other. Unaware of the emotions, Shivaay still plans to marry Tia.
Daksh, Shivaay's childhood friend turns up at his door and falls for Annika at first sight, which soon turns into an obsession. Angered after being rejected twice, Daksh lies to Shivaay that Annika agreed to sleep with him for one night in exchange for money, leading Shivaay to hate her.
On Shivaay and Tia's wedding day it is revealed that she is already married to Robin. Due to turn of events Tia runs away from her wedding which leads to Shivaay forcibly marrying Annika.
Meanwhile, Omkara crosses paths with Ishana, who introduces herself as Bela to him. Ishana wanted to marry Omkara to gain all the wealth he has, and invents lies to gain his sympathy. Ishana tries to trick both of them but fails as the three Oberoi brothers try to expose her. Some time later, Riddhima lies and betrays Omkara and collaborates with his father to make Omkara the sole heir of the Oberoi empire. Disheartened, he breaks up with her.
In the meantime, Rudra has a chance encounter with the cute and sweet Soumya, who consoles him as Shivaay's life is in danger. Rudra starts to like Romi, a hot fresher and tries his best to win her. By chance, Soumya also comes to college and is happy to see a familiar face, only to be ignored by Rudra as she is a little fat and that would have reduced his reputation. Due to the turn of events, and under the influence of alcohol, Rudra and Soumya marry, which they decide to conceal and forget.
After a rocky start, Annika and Shivaay clear the misunderstandings between them and eventually fall in love. Together, they expose Tia's marriage and her mother, Mrs. Kapoor's, evil intentions. Later, Shivaay publicly accepts Annika as his wife.
Due to Priyanka's pregnancy, Shivaay fixes her wedding with a police officer, Ranveer Randhawa, who hated Priyanka as she was the reason his sister died. Kamini Khurana Randhawa, Ranveer's adoptive mother, enters. She has a past with Shivaay's father as Shakti is constantly teased by his brother about Kamini. Kamini and Ranveer have an evil plan. Meanwhile, Shivaay's doppelganger kidnaps him and takes his place in the Oberoi mansion. Suspicious, Annika discovers that he is not the real Shivaay, she rushes to find and save the real one.
Together, they expose the fake Shivaay, Mahi. Simultaneously they expose Ranveer and his foster mother, Kamini who is Shivaay's father's former girlfriend. It is revealed that Mahi is Kamini's illegitimate son with Shakti as she wants to use her son for Oberoi wealth. Afterwards, it's revealed that Priyanka is not pregnant.
Omkara marries Gauri Kumari Sharma, but hates her and the concept of love (their story is shown more in the spinoff series Dil Boley Oberoi). At a party, Rudra falls in love with Bhavya, an undercover ACP on a mission. She later uses him for her mission, Rudra and Bhavya fake a marriage just so she can hide in the Oberoi mansion.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: On 18 June 2018, a reboot version, Ishqbaaaz: Redux, was launched with a new love story of the leads from the beginning.

articleSections.title: Cancellation
articleSections.text: Owing to its declining viewership ratings, it took a leap in December 2018 which starred Nakuul Mehta and Manjiri Pupala. As it failed to increase the ratings, Pupala's character was turned negative, resulting in her resignation. Eventually, Niti Taylor was hired to play Mannat Kaur Khurana. The expected ratings were not delivered and it went off air on 15 March 2019.

articleSections.title: Spin-off
articleSections.text: Dil Boley Oberoi, premiered on 13 February 2017. The show focused on the lives of Omkara and Rudra. It is the first Indian soap to have a spin-off. On 7 July 2017, Dil Boley Oberoi ended and the storyline was merged into Ishqbaaaz. In Dil Boley Oberoi, Shrenu Parikh was introduced as Kunal Jaisingh's character's love interest.

episodesList.title: Meet Shivay and His Brothers
episodesList.summary: Ishqbaaz is a new show about the three Oberoi brothers. Meet Shivaay, whose life's loves are business and his two brothers. Omkara, the second brother is an artist and the youngest Rudra believes life to be all about having fun. Catch their story.

episodesList.title: Anika, Shivaay Meet Again
episodesList.summary: On Omkara's insistence, Tej apologises to Janhvi for his misbehaviour. Later, Svetlana and Tej discuss their plan against Ashok. And what is Anika doing at the Oberois?

episodesList.title: Brothers Perform Maha Aarti
episodesList.summary: The minister sanctions Tej's projects. Later, the pandit tells him that the person who does the maha aarti will be the heir of the Oberois.

episodesList.title: Tej's Devious Plan
episodesList.summary: A stranger sets himself on fire during the maha aarti. Shivaay assures Dadi that he will stay with Omkara and Rudra. Tej tells Shakti about his plan to acquire the farmers' land!

episodesList.title: Tia's Wedding Plans
episodesList.summary: Pinki tells Shivaay about Tia's arrival. Tia tells her friends about her wedding plans. Later, Dadi learns that Tej and Shakti had lied to her.

episodesList.title: Shivaay Rescues Rudra
episodesList.summary: The Oberois humiliate Anika. Shivaay advises Priyanka to make friends with people who can match their stature in society. Shivaay and Omkara rescue Rudra from some goons.

episodesList.title: Anika's Cake Goes to the Oberois
episodesList.summary: Anika signs a contract to handle the college canteen. However, the cake she had made for Sahil l s birthday party is delivered to the Oberoi Mansion by mistake. Will Dadi reveal the truth?

episodesList.title: Janhvi Slaps Pinki !
episodesList.summary: Anika confronts Shivaay for insulting Sahil. However, she apologises to Shivaay on Sahil's insistence. Meanwhile, Janhvi slaps Pinki for humiliating Omkara

episodesList.title: Oberoi Mansion to Be Divided?
episodesList.summary: Dadi confronts everyone for their decision to divide the Oberoi Mansion. Omkara informs Shivaay that he has stopped taking drugs while Shivaay assures Dadi that he will stay with his brothers.

episodesList.title: Who's trying to Kill Shvaay?
episodesList.summary: Priyanka informs Shivaay that Anika came to collect her keys. A reporter, Geeta sends a video of Tej and Svetlana's private moments to Shivaay and demands a huge sum of money. Later, a stranger tries to kill Shivaay!

episodesList.title: Shivaay's Life is in Danger
episodesList.summary: A stranger abducts Sahil. Shivaay survives an attack on his life, but refuses to postpone his engagement

episodesList.title: Rudra Signs a Consent Form
episodesList.summary: The doctor tells Omkara that Shivaay has been poisoned. Rudra signs a consent form to admit Shivaay to the hospital and start his treatment. The doctor informs the Oberois about Shivaay's recovery. Meanwhile, Anika is shocked to learn that Sahil is missing.

episodesList.title: Anika Rescues Sahil
episodesList.summary: Anika finds a goon trying to abduct Sahil. Meanwhile, the stranger trying to kill Shivaay, gets caught. Later, Anika and a few other people rescue Sahil from the goon. Omkara and Rudra try to cheer Shivaay up after he regains consciousness.

episodesList.title: Anika Wants Sahil's Custody
episodesList.summary: Anika and Sahil threaten Sundari and walk out of her house. Meanwhile, Shivaay is discharged from the hospital. The cops think Anika to be Sahil's kidnapper!

episodesList.title: Will Shivaay Find the Chip?
episodesList.summary: Shivaay is shocked to see Anika in his room. He searches her bag for the chip while she lies unconscious.

episodesList.title: Om, Rudra are Arrested!
episodesList.summary: Anika finds the chip in the police station and gives it to Shivaay. Later, Omkara and Rudra are arrested. Meanwhile, Janhvi is shocked to see Tej and Svetlana's video on the news channel

episodesList.title: Shivaay Threatens Anika
episodesList.summary: The Oberois are shattered to see the news of Tej and Svetlana on television. Shivaay believes that Anika had sold the chip to the reporter and threatens her.

episodesList.title: Om Tries to Kill Himself!
episodesList.summary: Anika asks Shivaay to leave. Tej confronts Svetlana for giving the video footage to the media. Later, Roop and Svetlana discuss their plan against the Oberois. Omkara attempts suicide!

episodesList.title: Roop Plots against Tej and Janhvi
episodesList.summary: The Principal informs Anika that she lost the contract as the new trustee of the college has rejected her name. He asks Anika to meet the new trustee. Anika visits Mr. Mukherji's office to meet him. Meanwhile, Roop informs Pinki about her plan to ruin Tej and Janhvi's relationship.

episodesList.title: Shivaay Plans Against Anika
episodesList.summary: Anika learns that Shivaay is the college trustee. Meanwhile, a girl stalks Omkara. Shakti asks Pinki to stay away from Roop. Shivaay bribes Anika's lawyer to put her in trouble.

soundtrack.title: Ishqbaaaz: Tracklisting
soundtrack.composer: The Ishqbaaaz soundtrack was written by Shaheen Iqbal and composed by Sanjeev Srivastava. Sanjeev Srivastava had composed the original songs and background score for the show. The original version of the album was released on 7 August 2016. "O Jaana", the theme song of the serial was performed by Pamela Jain and Bhaven Dhanak.

plotHtml:
Kalyani Singh Oberoi, the matriarch of the family has two sons, Tej and Shakti. Tej is married to Jhanvi and they have three children, Omkara, Rudra and Priyanka. Shakti is married to Pinky and has a son, Shivaay, who is the eldest grandson.
This story is about the Oberoi brothers, Shivaay, Omkara and Rudra, friendship and romances.
Shivaay crosses paths with the self righteous Annika, who confronts him for trying to suppress the poor with the misuse money and lineage. To which, Shivaay gives her a bunch of cash. Presuming that he won the conversation, he moves to his car, only to face Annika breaking the glass of his windshield, and returning him the same bunch of cash, earning the nickname "Khidki-tod".
Surprised by the video showing all these incidents, Dadi, Omkara, and Rudra find Annika at the party they had organized for their grandfather's birthday. But Shivaay ignores her there because he has no knowledge about her bloodline or lineage.
Shivaay firmly believes that he has no time for love and hence plans to marry Tia Kapoor as a business deal. Dadi hires Anika as a wedding planner for Shivaay and Tia's upcoming wedding. At first, his relationship with Annika becomes more hostile due to misunderstandings.
After the misunderstandings are cleared, Shivaay starts to understand Annika and they develop feelings for each other. Unaware of the emotions, Shivaay still plans to marry Tia.
Daksh, Shivaay's childhood friend turns up at his door and falls for Annika at first sight, which soon turns into an obsession. Angered after being rejected twice, Daksh lies to Shivaay that Annika agreed to sleep with him for one night in exchange for money, leading Shivaay to hate her.
On Shivaay and Tia's wedding day it is revealed that she is already married to Robin. Due to turn of events Tia runs away from her wedding which leads to Shivaay forcibly marrying Annika.
Meanwhile, Omkara crosses paths with Ishana, who introduces herself as Bela to him. Ishana wanted to marry Omkara to gain all the wealth he has, and invents lies to gain his sympathy. Ishana tries to trick both of them but fails as the three Oberoi brothers try to expose her. Some time later, Riddhima lies and betrays Omkara and collaborates with his father to make Omkara the sole heir of the Oberoi empire. Disheartened, he breaks up with her.
In the meantime, Rudra has a chance encounter with the cute and sweet Soumya, who consoles him as Shivaay's life is in danger. Rudra starts to like Romi, a hot fresher and tries his best to win her. By chance, Soumya also comes to college and is happy to see a familiar face, only to be ignored by Rudra as she is a little fat and that would have reduced his reputation. Due to the turn of events, and under the influence of alcohol, Rudra and Soumya marry, which they decide to conceal and forget.
After a rocky start, Annika and Shivaay clear the misunderstandings between them and eventually fall in love. Together, they expose Tia's marriage and her mother, Mrs. Kapoor's, evil intentions. Later, Shivaay publicly accepts Annika as his wife.
Due to Priyanka's pregnancy, Shivaay fixes her wedding with a police officer, Ranveer Randhawa, who hated Priyanka as she was the reason his sister died. Kamini Khurana Randhawa, Ranveer's adoptive mother, enters. She has a past with Shivaay's father as Shakti is constantly teased by his brother about Kamini. Kamini and Ranveer have an evil plan. Meanwhile, Shivaay's doppelganger kidnaps him and takes his place in the Oberoi mansion. Suspicious, Annika discovers that he is not the real Shivaay, she rushes to find and save the real one.
Together, they expose the fake Shivaay, Mahi. Simultaneously they expose Ranveer and his foster mother, Kamini who is Shivaay's father's former girlfriend. It is revealed that Mahi is Kamini's illegitimate son with Shakti as she wants to use her son for Oberoi wealth. Afterwards, it's revealed that Priyanka is not pregnant.
Omkara marries Gauri Kumari Sharma, but hates her and the concept of love (their story is shown more in the spinoff series Dil Boley Oberoi). At a party, Rudra falls in love with Bhavya, an undercover ACP on a mission. She later uses him for her mission, Rudra and Bhavya fake a marriage just so she can hide in the Oberoi mansion.

title: Ishq Ka Rang Safed
summary:
Ishq Ka Rang Safed (transl. White is the color of love) is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series. That aired on Colors TV from 10 August 2015 to 26 August 2016. The show portrays the story of a young widow, Dhaani, and a rich boy, Viplav, who falls in love with her and goes against the orthodox views of society to marry her. The show was mostly accepted by the viewers and gave tough competition to Star Plus's Suhani Si Ek Ladki.
Rekha Bhardwaj re-recorded content from her 2011 album Kabir Chaura Sufi Chaura for the show. The program was later telecasted on Colors Rishtey as Mohe Rang Do Laal.
plot:
Viplav Tripathi, the carefree grandson of Dashrath Tripathi, meets Dhaani, a young widow on the bank of the river Ganges in the holy city of Banaras. Dhaani lives with her mother in a widow refuge (aashram). Viplav, a law graduate, plans to go to the US for further studies. They get off to a bad start, and Viplav takes revenge from Dhaani for disrespecting him but soon realizes his mistake. Viplav continues to play pranks on Dhaani, but eventually genuinely apologizes.
Dashrath sends Viplav to Delhi, and tries to have the aashram vacated. Viplav arrives just in time to fight the court case on behalf of the widows. Viplav's parents try to get him engaged to his childhood friend, Tanya but Viplav calls off the engagement. When he saves Dhaani from drowning, his half brother, Tripurari, takes photographs to defame Dhaani. An enraged Viplav decides to live with the widows till their problems are solved.
Dhaani and Viplav become friends. After helping the widows, Viplav returns home. Viplav's parents again create misunderstandings leading to Dhaani and Viplav breaking off their friendship. Dhaani is made to get engaged to Tripurari but Viplav stops their wedding in the nick of time after discovering Tripurari had gotten another widow, Suvarna, pregnant.
Viplav's mother, Kanak, employs Tripurari to get Dhaani killed but Viplav saves her. He is, however, injured and Dhaani and he take refuge in a woman's cottage pretending to be a married couple. They spend several days together during which Viplav falls in love with her. Tripurari catches up with them and when they are brought to Banaras, Viplav declares his love for Dhaani and announces he will marry her. A confused Dhaani rejects his proposal but when he pretends to leave for the US she realises her feelings for him and happily accepts.
Kanak and Dashrath create several problems for the couple leading to them arguing but eventually Viplav sees through their plans and he and Dhaani marry in a temple. At home, they find a family visiting Viplav's house to arrange a marriage alliance for his sister, Shalu and decide not to share the news.
Shalu is engaged to Raja who, unbeknownst to all, turns out to be Dhaani's ex-husband's brother. Raja is looking for his brother's wife, Suman (now Dhaani), who he blames for his brother's death and enlists Viplav's help. Dhaani realises Raja's identity and stops the wedding. She is arrested for her husband's death and Viplav decides to fight her case. She reveals that her husband was an alcoholic and her mother-in-law beat her. On the night of his death, Raja tried to force himself on her and in trying to save her, her drunk husband fell off a balcony and died. In court, instigated by the opposing lawyer, Viplav announces he is Dhaani's husband shocking everyone. He presents evidence that exonerates Dhaani and takes her home.
Dashrath pretends to accept her, while Kanak and Shalu are against her. Shalu gets manipulated by Raja, and marries him. Viplav and Dhaani come up with multiple plans to expose Raja. Finally, Raja's father helps them and Raja is revealed to be a married man who goes around conning women for their money. Raja is thrown out and Shalu asks forgiveness. As the family get together to perform a pooja, Raja returns to attack Dhaani but Viplav gets in the way and is injured. Dhaani beats up Raja who is finally arrested and Viplav is rushed to the hospital. Kanak blames Dhaani for her son's condition. Dhaani prays and Viplav recovers.
Dashrath's sister comes to live with the family. Dadi Bua wants to find a suitable girl for Viplav and the family lie to her that Dhaani is a nurse caring for him. Dadi Bua introduces Kaamini as a suitable match. As days pass, Shalu marries Pankaj. When Dhaani is asked to leave the house, Viplav brings her back and announces that they are married shocking Dadi Bua and Kaamini. Dadi Bua convinces Kaamini to stay on.
Kaamini befriends Viplav and Dhaani. Wanting to surprise Viplav, Dhaani asks Kaamini for help to attend school. Kaamini sends her to night school and makes trying to make Viplav suspicious. Dhaani succeeds at school and Viplav finally finds out and is proud of her. Kaamini creates misunderstandings between the couple causing Dhaani to move to the aashram when she discovers she is pregnant. She writes a letter to Viplav which Kaamini intercepts. Later that night, Kaamini gets Viplav drunk and makes it look like they have been intimate. A heartbroken Dhaani decides to leave the city for good. Tripurari plants a bomb at the aashram that goes off killing everyone.

articleSections.title: Five Years later
articleSections.text:
Source:
Dhaani (now played by Sanjeeda Sheikh) lives in Mumbai with her mother and daughter in a chawl and is helped by Parshya, a former goon while Viplav is in Banaras living with Dhaani's memories. He has married Kaamini and is father to a young boy Atharva. As fate would have it, Viplav and Dhaani meet at a wedding in Mumbai where Dhaani is working as a flower decorator. Dhaani behaves coldly towards him and Viplav gets disheartened.
Once again, Kaamini creates misunderstandings causing Dhaani to decide on marrying Parshya. Viplav is heartbroken at the separation from Dhaani and their daughter, Vidha. On the wedding day, Vidha faints and is rushed to the hospital thus halting the wedding ceremony.
Daadi bua returns and reveals everything. An emotional reunion takes place as Viplav and Dhaani now plan to make Tripurari and Kaamini pay for their misdeeds. Finally, all the culprits are sent to prison after they confess their crimes. Viplav, Dhaani along with Vidha and Atharva, then live happily in the aashram reminiscing the happier moments of their past.

title: India's Next Top Model
summary:
India's Next Top Model is an Indian reality television series, which premiered on 19 July 2015 and broadcast on MTV India. The series is an Indian version of Tyra Banks-created 2003 American reality television series America's Next Top Model. The viewers see several women compete for the title of India's Next Top Model, providing them with an opportunity to begin their career in the modeling industry.
The Head judge/Host of the series is Lisa Haydon later Malaika Arora, Judged by Dabboo Ratnani, Milind Soman (seasons 3–4) And mentored by image consultant and grooming expert Neeraj Gaba and Anusha Dandekar. Bulldog Media & Entertainment had licensed the format rights from CBS Television Distribution and the series was premiered on 19 July 2015 on MTV India.
The show got rebooted into a new format in 2018 named Top Model India season 1 on Colors Infinity, sister channel of MTV India that included both men and women competing for the title whereas MTV India created a new version for female only models called MTV Supermodel of the Year.

title: Ichche Nodee
summary: Ichche Nodee, also spelled as Ichchenodi (English: A wish fulfilling river), is a Bengali television soap opera that premiered on 15 June 2015, and aired on Star Jalsha. It was written by Leena Gangopadhyay and produced by Saibal Banerjee of Magic Moments Motion Pictures. It featured Vikram Chatterjee and Solanki Roy in lead roles, Sritama Bhattacharjee in a negative role, Aishwarya Sen in a negative role later positive, and Chandan Sen and Laboni Sarkar in pivotal roles. After running for almost two years, the show ended on 28 May 2017, after airing 712 episodes.
plot:
Ichchenodi is a story of sibling rivalry set within the premise of a love triangle. Ichhenodi basically revolves around a story of two sisters, Meghla and Adrija, and how they entangle themselves in a relationship with their love interest, Anurag.
Meghla, who finds the essence of her life in music, is fond of her elder sister Adrija, and loves her above anyone else. The sisters get caught up in a love triangle making their life go upside down. Meghla is proud of her elder sister Adrija as she is a smart, beautiful girl, who is a topper as well when it comes to study. However, Adrija despises her since childhood and hates her after she discovers that Meghla is not her own sister but adopted. Chandan loves both Meghla and Adrija equally while Mahua, Chandan's wife loves Adrija more since she is their own daughter and Megha is adoptive. Chandan is proud of Adrija for being a topper but he also supports Meghla's passion for singing and wants her to become an established singer. Adrija begins to love Anurag madly but Anurag falls in love with the simple and docile Meghla, and her passion for music. Meghla refuses him and tries to convince him to marry Adrija but circumstances compel them to marry each other. Adrija creates many misunderstandings to destroy the marital life of Meghla and Anurag. Chandan tries his best to reform Adrija but Adrija pretends to be innocent. Chandan tries strict measures and warnings but nothing seems to work. Adrija even tried to create misunderstanding between Chandan and Meghla but instead their relationship became stronger. Chandan gives Adrija a final warning and says that he will disown her if she continues like this. Adrija still doesn't seem to change.
Adrija is finally successful in making Meghla leave Anurag's house after unlimited misunderstandings. Anurag's mother Malobika trusts Adrija and misunderstands Meghla. Chandan supports Meghla and stands beside her even when everyone is against her. Adrija feeds false stories and emotionally manipulates a depressed Meghla to send divorce papers to Anurag. However after sending the divorce papers Meghla tries to kill herself. Chandan is devastated and blames Anurag and his family. Anurag is extremely guilty and apologies to Meghla along with his family for misunderstanding her. Once Meghla recovers she reveals how adrija emotionally manipulated her and said countless lies to make her feel worthless and sign the divorce papers. Depressed and frustrated Chandan disowns Adrija. Anurag and his family apologies to Meghla and Meghla decides to stay with them. Adrija collaborated with her college friend Subhankar and planned to character assassinate Meghla and kill her. But eventually she fails as Subhankar repents. Chandan and Anurag's cousin Piklu reveals the truth and Chandan gets Adrija and Subhankar arrested. Chandan motivates Meghla to be a strong person but he is depressed for Adrija. Anurag and Meghla face issues due to the aftermath of the incident but eventually reconciles. Later Anurag's distant relative Nandini creates countless problems as apparently she can't see anyone happy. But still Anurag and Meghla's love wins.
After few months Adrija is bailed out by her parents. Adrija seems depressed so Chandan and Mahua takes her for a trip and constantly motivates her to start her life afresh. Anurag and Meghla coincidentally arrives at the same place for their honeymoon. Coincidentally Adrija and Anurag meets and Adrija unleashes her wrath on Anurag. Out of frustration, she pushes Anurag from a cliff, who is then saved by Tua, also a passionate singer. Anurag loses his memory in the accident and is named "Vikram" by Tua and her family. Tua starts loving Vikram, without knowing his past. Adrija now marries Piklu and enters his family to torture Meghla and makes her life hell by instigating Malobika against her, rendering Meghla responsible for Anurag's supposed death and portrays Meghla as a cheap and characterless girl in the eyes of the family members. Nandini helps Adrija in isolating Meghla. A distraught and lonely Meghla finds solace in music and is pacified by her Guru Maa, who turns out to be her own biological mother. Also Chandan constantly supports and motivates Meghla. She soon finds out that Anurag is alive and after many obstacles, they finally reunite (as Anurag's memory returns) on the day of Anurag and Tua's marriage. Anurag reveals how Adrija tried to kill him but except Anurag's elder brother Bumba and his wife Kajori, everyone else thinks that Anurag is misunderstanding Adrija. Meghla despises Adrija after hearing what she did to Anurag. She decides to break all relations with her and Chandan rejects Adrija as his daughter. But Malobika blames Meghla for not informing her about Anurag being alive and thinks that she is an opportunist.
Tua along with her aunt, Sharmistha then join forces with Adrija to separate Meghla from Anurag. On the other hand Meghla turns into a strong individual who has learnt to take stands for herself and speak the truth when required. Anurag and Kajori strongly supports Meghla's change. After Adrija's instigation, Tua and Sharmistha file a case against Anurag, accusing him of deceit and polygamy, but they fail due to the intervention of Adv. Shubhalakshmi, an experienced lawyer. Meghla also helps her to mend her broken relationship with her estranged husband, Adv. Anweshan. Malobika realise her mistakes and apologies to Meghla. Shattered and ashamed of her deeds, Tua changes herself and becomes a loyal confidante to Meghla, despite Anurag's initial reluctance. Sharmistha also repents and reforms herself. Meghla, Anurag and the banerjees asks Adrija to leave the house but Adrija threatens to use her woman rights. Chandan legally disowns her and decides to collect all evidence against her and fight a legal battle. Seeing Meghla alone in the house Adrija goes desperate and tries to stab her but Anurag saves Meghla. Adrija declares to everyone and the police that she will kill definitely kill Meghla one day. Adrija gets arrested while Chandan is depressed to see his daughter behaving like this.
Adrija flees from police custody and takes the alias of "Mallika Dasgupta" to hide herself from the public eye. Deep Dasgupta, husband of the real Mallika (who is now dead), promises to help Adrija without knowledge of her true intentions. Soon Meghla gets pregnant and everyone in the family become happy. But their happiness is short-lived as Adrija kills Meghla's unborn baby while trying to kill her. A devastated Anurag blames Meghla for everything and asks for a separation. Meghla, unable to bear Anurag's indifference, files for divorce, and soon, their divorce happens. Meghla restarts her singing career, while Deep helps Chandan to get Adrija arrested. Anurag decides to move to the United States. and spends a night with Meghla before his departure. Meghla gets pregnant again but decides to tell nobody about her prospective baby.

articleSections.title: 2 years later
articleSections.text: A widowed Malobika misses Anurag and Meghla's presence in the family. Mimi, Anurag's elder cousin sister, returns home, as she promised to Anurag to take over the responsibilities of the Banerjee family in his absence, and also becomes a strong emotional support to Meghla. Meghla, who is now a famous playback singer, raises her son (with Anurag), namely Roddur single-handedly. Adrija returns in Piklu's life after her release from jail and consequent, change in disposition. She soon becomes pregnant and transforms into a good-hearted person who cares for Piklu and his family. She restores her love towards Meghla and like others, also wants Meghla and Anurag's reunion. Chandan forgives Adrija. Anurag becomes a famous playback singer known as "AB" in order to get close to Meghla. Lastly, Mimi and Sanjoy, Pagla Ghora (Anurag's uncle) and Shabnam get married. Meghla and Anurag too finally reunite and take care of the family and Roddur together. Adrija and Piklu too have a baby girl; and everything ends well for all

title: India Poochega Sabse Shaana Kaun?
summary: India Poochega: Sabse Shaana Kaun? is an Indian reality game show hosted by actor Shah Rukh Khan. Adapted from the "Who's Asking?" international format, it opened on 2 March 2015 on Zee Network's newly launched entertainment channel &TV. The format of the show is simple. Two pairs compete against each other for a winning amount of ₹10 million (US$100,000). They will first be asked questions by ordinary people. Once they clear that round, a galaxy of celebrities will ask the winning pair a set of questions. The usual lifelines are present and so on.
reception: Subramanian Harikumar of Bollywood Life gave the show 3.5 out of 5 stars and said, "India Poochega: Sabse Shaana Kaun has everything that you expect from a Shah Rukh Khan show and the actor has put his best foot forward, turning on the charm to full swing, adding glitz and glamour to a rather simple yet entertaining show."

articleSections.title: Format
articleSections.text: The show is a first of its kind where the common man will don the hat of the 'asker', as well as that of the contestant. While the 'askers' shall pose the questions, the contestants will be seen demonstrating their street-smartness to win big bucks. In the first round, the contestants have to look at the options on the screen and pick a questioner for themselves. In the second round, the opposite team has to pick one for their competitors. The finalists will face a pyramid of 15 celebrity questioners.

title: Itna Karo Na Mujhe Pyaar
summary: Itna Karo Na Mujhe Pyaar (transl.  Don't Love Me So Much) is an Indian Hindi-language television soap opera which premiered on Sony Entertainment Television And Zee TV. Produced by Balaji Telefilms, the show deals with the relationship challenges of a divorced couple and how they remain connected because of their children.
plot:
Ragini Patel is a divorcée and lives with her two children Nishi and Aarav and her mother Asha and grandmother Bakula Nani. She is a strong and independent woman who works in a hospital as an administrative head under the hospital owner Dr. Aman Malhotra.
Dr. Neil Khanna, who is Ragini's ex-husband, lives in New York City with his three children Ranbir, Agham, Suhani and his sister Pam. Aarav, Nishi and her fiancé Jignesh find out that Neil lives in New York City. They insisted Neil to come to India to attend Nishi's marriage. Later after clearing the misunderstandings Neil and Ragini decide to live together again but due to circumstances they get separated.

plotHtml:
Ragini Patel is a divorcée and lives with her two children Nishi and Aarav and her mother Asha and grandmother Bakula Nani. She is a strong and independent woman who works in a hospital as an administrative head under the hospital owner Dr. Aman Malhotra.
Dr. Neil Khanna, who is Ragini's ex-husband, lives in New York City with his three children Ranbir, Agham, Suhani and his sister Pam. Aarav, Nishi and her fiancé Jignesh find out that Neil lives in New York City. They insisted Neil to come to India to attend Nishi's marriage. Later after clearing the misunderstandings Neil and Ragini decide to live together again but due to circumstances they get separated.
tagline: Ragini Patel is a divorcée and lives with her two children Nishi and Aarav and her mother Asha and grandmother Bakula Nani.

title: India's Raw Star
summary: India's Raw Star is an Indian singing competition series created by Gajendra Singh of Saibaba Telefilms which began airing on Star Plus from 24 August 2014. It was hosted by model-actress and Bigg Boss 7 winner Gauahar Khan and mentored by singer-rapper Yo Yo Honey Singh. Rituraj Mohanty  won the first season on 30 November 2014 with Darshan Raval and Mohit Gaur finishing second and third respectively. The other contestants were Sagar Bhatia, Akasa Singh, pardeep singh sran etc. Mohan Rathore, winner of a Bhojpuri singing competition 'Sur Sangram' was also one of the contestants. Arjun Kapoor and Deepika Padukone made guest appearances in the show. India's Raw Star witnessed singers like Kailash Kher, Mohit Chauhan and Shaan perform in the final episode with finalists Rituraj, Mohit and Darshan. The finalists sang the final face off song composed by Sachin and Jigar on the occasion, while Arjun Kapoor, promoted his film Tevar.
reception:
Vinod Talreja of Bollywoodlife.com rated the series 3.5/5 and wrote "The first episode of India's Raw Star definitely impressed us. All the music lovers who are looking for something different will surely love it. We hope it doesn't lose the plot and keeps going like this in coming episodes."
Prathamesh Jadhav from India.com said "The show is a fresh concept indeed, but it ultimately resorts to the gimmicky efforts ( for instance, back story for every contender) that stretches the duration unnecessarily."

title: Izteraab
summary: Izteraab is a 2014 Pakistani television series that aired on Hum TV and was written by Amna Mufti and directed by Misbah Khalid. It is produced by M&M Productions. It stars Saba Qamar and Mekaal Zulfiqar in their second on-screen collaboration after Pani Jaisa Piyar in 2011.
plot: Izteraab is the tale of a man having two wives. Jazib fell in love with Zara, and they married. Jazib is conservative by nature, whereas his wife Zara is liberal minded, which causes disagreements between them resulting in separation. Jazib then marries Dua. The story takes a new turn when he learns that Zara has cancer. Later, Jazib and Zara reunite. It is implied that Dua leaves to do some social work so Jazib and Zara and their children can work to become a family again.
