Payal and Buaji are stunned to see Arnav getting an unconscious Khushi home. They hold Arnav responsible for Khushi’s condition. Arnav feels guilty seeing Khushi unconscious.

episodesList.title: Arnav Thinks of Khushi
episodesList.summary: Payal is anxious when Khushi remains unconscious for long. Anjali is alarmed when she sees Arnav's injured hand. Arnav refuses to discuss about Lavanya with Naniji. Khushi regains her consciousness and wonders how she came home.

episodesList.title: Khushi Considers Going Back
episodesList.summary: Anjali asks Arnav to be honest with himself. She asks him to stop bothering Khushi. Nani is keen on getting Arnav married and brings him a marriage proposal. Payal thinks that Khushi should go back to Lucknow. Will she go back?

episodesList.title: A Thoughtful Akash
episodesList.summary: Buaji decides to intervene. He  promises to stop Khushi from working for Arnav. Manorama is intent on getting a rich daughter-in-law. Akash is trying to come to terms with his mother’s expectations. He keeps thinking of Payal.

episodesList.title: Khushi Plans to Resign
episodesList.summary: Khushi decides to resign. A lot of people are happy about her decision. Payal is happy as she and Khushi can go back to Lucknow. Arnav is irked to see Lavanya, Sim and Pam making fun of Khushi. Arnav rushes home when Manorama informs him of Anjali not keeping well.

episodesList.title: Khushi Resigns
episodesList.summary: Khushi submits her resignation to Arnav. She accuses of him for ruining her life. Anjali, however, apologises for Arnav’s past behaviour and Khushi is touched. Payal asks Shyam to give Khushi a job, so that they can help Buaji financially. Interestingly, Buaji asks Shyam about his family.

episodesList.title: Khushi and Arnav Think About Each Other
episodesList.summary: Khushi and Arnav  think about each other. Khushi feels guilty about accusing him. He, too, is thinking about Khushi a lot. Anjali plans a big Teej puja and Arnav supports this idea. Will Khushi and Arnav express  their feelings to each other?

episodesList.title: Arnav and Nani Argue
episodesList.summary: Arnav has an argument with Nani and decides to leave the house. Even though Nani is upset, she does not relent. Anjali pleads with Arnav to stay and this makes him to change his mind.

episodesList.title: Shyam Keeps Anjali Waiting
episodesList.summary: Anjali teases Arnav when she catches him gazing at Khushi’s photograph. Shyam seems to be falling for Khushi as well. His wife, Anjali, is waiting for him to turn up for the puja. Arnav makes a promise to keep Anjali happy.

episodesList.title: Everyone Meets at the Temple
episodesList.summary: Payal, Khushi, Arnav, Anjali and Akash are all at the temple. Arnav and Khushi run into each other  while buying items for the Puja. Anjali notices Akash trying to get a better glimpse of Payal. Will she tell anybody anything about this?

episodesList.title: Shyam Is Enchanted by Khushi
episodesList.summary: Shyam is enthralled by the sight of Khushi in a sari. She tells him about meeting Anjali at the temple. Anjali gets gifts from her husband. Khushi tells Madhumati about meeting Arnav at the temple. What is Shyam going to do about his feelings?

episodesList.title: Khushi in Arnav's Arms
episodesList.summary: Khushi and Payal  realise that they have Anjali’s puja plate. Khushi rushes to return it. Lavanya, who is invited by Anjali, turns up at the temple, looking very traditional. Khushi  faints and ends up in Arnav’s arms again.

episodesList.title: Khushi Breaks Her Fast With Arnav
episodesList.summary: Arnav revives Khushi by giving her some water, thus breaking her fast. Anjali waits patiently for her husband to turn up so that she can break her fast as well. Her husband calls her and tells her that he will be there soon.

episodesList.title: Shyam at the Temple
episodesList.summary: Khushi leaves the temple early. Shyam arrivest the temple and helps his wife, Anjali, break her fast. Before leaving the temple premises however, Khushi remembers that she has not collected her puja plate. She goes back to get the same. Will she see Shyam?

episodesList.title: Shyam and Anjali Renew Vows
episodesList.summary: Madhumati questions Khushi. She asks her when she broke the fast, before or after the Puja. Anjali is very moved by Shyam helping her to break her fast. They renew their marital vows. Has Shyam stopped thinking of Khushi?

episodesList.title: Khushi and Payal Talk About Akash
episodesList.summary: Khushi talks to Payal about Aakash. Shyam prepares sugar free jilebis for Arnav. Arnav asks Shyam to let Anjali stay with her family for a few more days instead of moving into Shyam's house and staying there alone

episodesList.title: Lavanya in the Raizada House
episodesList.summary: Arnav and Nani argue about Lavanya.  Nani agrees that she can stay in the house. Khushi wants to retrieve a figurine from her office desk before she leaves. A nervous Khushi goes into Arnav’s office.

episodesList.title: Arnav and Khushi Fight Again
episodesList.summary: Khushi ignores Arnav and goes into the storeroom to retrieve her figurine. An angry Arnav follows her and  breaks her mobile phone when she refuses to acknowledge his presence. Meanwhile, Anjali is very confused about Arnav and Lavanya's relation.

episodesList.title: The Saga of Pure Love
episodesList.summary: Khushi, a simple girl and Arnav Singh Raizada, a business tycoon come together only to realise that their conflicting personalities have entwined them in a web of eternal love.

episodesList.title: Khushi, Arnav Fall in Love
episodesList.summary: Arnav and Khushi find solace in each other's company as they celebrate festivals like Holi and Krishna Janmashtami together. Arnav gets romantic with Khushi.

episodesList.title: Nani lays down rules for Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Khushi requests Shyam to help her look for a job. Meanwhile, Nani is unhappy to see Lavanya come home. She refuses to let her to stay in Arnav's room. This upsets Arnav and he threatens to leave the house. However, Shyam consoles him and asks him to consider Nani's decision.

episodesList.title: Manorama warns Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Anjali asks Nani to give Lavanya a chance to prove herself. Lavanya is shocked to know that Nani plans to test her. Arnav is angry when Nani questions Lavanya on her cooking skills. On the other hand, Khushi and Payal decide to leave for Lucknow. However, Anjali's decision to meet Khushi shocks Arnav and Shyam.

episodesList.title: Nani allots task to Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Khushi is in a dilemma about leaving Delhi. Lavanya is shocked when Nani asks her to prepare dinner. Meanwhile, Shyam decides to meet Khushi. Arnav on the other hand, also keeps thinking about Khushi.

episodesList.title: Arnav and Anjali meet Shyam
episodesList.summary: Shyam is shocked to see Anjali and Arnav, but lies to them when Anjali questions him. Meanwhile, Lavanya and Manorama are disastrous in kitchen. Khushi is touched when Buaji gives her jalebis for the journey, but an idea strikes her and she convinces them about it. She opens a sweet shop in front of their house.

episodesList.title: Khushi sets up a sweet shop
episodesList.summary: Manorama and Lavanya are tired preparing dinner. On the other hand, Khushi, Payal and Madhumati set up shop and wait for customers. Meanwhile, Nani doubts Lavanya's cooking skills and Manorama reveals the truth about the dinner preparation. Nani and Arnav are upset with Lavanya's lie.

episodesList.title: Khushi's business in trouble
episodesList.summary: Payal and Buaji are worried about Khushi's failing business, but she asks them to have faith. Nani warns everybody against helping Lavanya with her tasks. While, Anjali is surprised to see Shyam worried, Arnav continues thinking about Khushi. Later, Nani sees Lavanya going into Arnav's room.

episodesList.title: Khushi's new idea
episodesList.summary: Nani asks Lavanya to leave Arnav's room. Shyam is relieved to know that Khushi is still in Delhi. The next morning, Manorama wakes up Lavanya and asks her attend the aarti. Meanwhile, Khushi decides to distribute sweets to the nearby hotels to help her get orders.

episodesList.title: Khushi gets order for sweets
episodesList.summary: Nani scolds Lavanya and asks her to leave. Payal and Khushi worry when they fail to get orders, but are delighted when they get to deliver sweets to a high profile party. Meanwhile, Arnav is furious with himself for continually thinking about Khushi and decides to forget her.

episodesList.title: Khushi is stunned to learn about her first client
episodesList.summary: Arnav and Nani decide to keep their differences aside during Anjali and Shyam's anniversary party. Payal and Khushi are elated as they finish preparing the sweets for the party. Anjali is delighted to see the surprise Shyam plans for her. Khushi is shell-shocked to learn from the manager that she needs to deliver the sweets to Raizada house. Payal talks sense into Khushi and requests her to complete the order so that they can get back Madhumati's bangles from the pawn shop. Nani is furious when Lavanya drops the sweet dish which she had prepared for Shyam. Khushi realises the problems at home and decides to deliver the sweets to Arnav's house. Khushi is scared to enter Arnav's house.

episodesList.title: Khushi wants to see Anjali's beauty
episodesList.summary: Arnav is shocked to find Khushi in his cupboard. However, Anjali tells him about Khushi getting the contract for the sweets. Khushi fails to see Shyam, but is insulted by Arnav. Later, Shyam is astonished to see Khushi in the party.

episodesList.title: Manorama spoils the sweets
episodesList.summary: Nani disapproves of Lavanya's dance performance and complains to Anjali. While a frustrated Lavanya drinks, Shyam escapes the party. Meanwhile, Khushi consoles Anjali. In the meantime, Manorama spoils the sweets, forcing the manager to cancel Khushi's contract.

episodesList.title: Lavanya insults Nani
episodesList.summary: Manorama tries to poison Nani and Anjali against Khushi, but they support her and ask her serve the sweets to the guests. Meanwhile, a drunk Lavanya insults Nani, prompting Arnav to ask her to apologise. Nani scolds Manorama for supporting Lavanya. Later, Madhumati is shocked to hear about the spoilt sweets.

episodesList.title: Anjali and Manorama meet Khushi
episodesList.summary: Lavanya apologises for insulting Nani and for spoiling the party. The contractor refuses to pay Khushi. On the other hand, Shyam tries to convince Khushi to go back to Lucknow. However, he leaves Khushi's house when he sees Anjali coming.

episodesList.title: Anjali asks for Khushi's help
episodesList.summary: Anjali asks Khushi to train Lavanya, but she declines the offer stating Arnav's presence as the reason. She tells Khushi that as per the terms, she has to pay them if she breaches the contract. Anjali leaves the decision to her. Later, Shyam offers help with the money to be paid to Anjali.

episodesList.title: Khushi accepts Anjali's offer
episodesList.summary: Shyam tries to convince Khushi against accepting Anjali's offer. Nani is upset with Lavanya and wishes to see a girl like Khushi in the house. She comes to Raizada house while Anjali and Manorama talk about her. However, Lavanya opposes Khushi's presence in the house and decides to leave.

episodesList.title: Khushi starts training Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Khushi convinces Nani about training Lavanya. Nani talks to Laxmi about her plan with Khushi. Meanwhile, Anjali asks Khushi to tie rakhi to Shyam. Later, she teaches Lavanya to make ginger tea and snacks. Anjali asks them to prepare dinner. Arnav asks Khushi to leave on seeing her in the kitchen.

episodesList.title: Arnav upsets Anjali
episodesList.summary: Arnav misbehaves with Anjali when he learns that she had asked Khushi to come. He insults Khushi and asks her to leave. Anjali is upset with Arnav, who leaves house feeling guilty. However, he then goes to Khushi's house and pays her to do Anjali's work.

episodesList.title: Arnav and Khushi look for Anjali
episodesList.summary: Anjali goes missing. Nani asks Arnav and Khushi to look for her when they come home. However, Arnav blames Khushi for the troubles. He finally finds Anjali in a temple and apologises for being rude. Later, Anjali calls Shyam and tells him that Khushi is waiting for him to tie the rakhiAnjali goes missing. Nani asks Arnav and Khushi to look for her when they come home. However, Arnav blames Khushi for the troubles. He finally finds Anjali in a temple and apologises for being rude. Later, Anjali calls Shyam and tells him that Khushi is waiting for him to tie the rakhi.

episodesList.title: Lavanya's explanation
episodesList.summary: Lavanya explains the idea of a live-in relationship to Khushi. Meanwhile, Arnav asks Lavanya to choose between house and office. On the other hand, Shyam fails to provoke Khushi against the Raizada to keep her away from them.

episodesList.title: Khushi to avoid Arnav
episodesList.summary: Shyam pretends to be innocent in front of Anjali and her family. Khushi thinks about Arnav and Lavanya's relationship. Lavanya on the other hand tells Arnav about Khushi's decision. Later, Anjali asks Khushi to explain Janmashtami to Lavanya.

episodesList.title: Khushi's family is invited
episodesList.summary: Khushi narrates the story of Lord Krishna and everybody gets carried away by it. Arnav humiliates Khushi again, but Nani supports her and asks him to behave. Later, Nani invites Khushi's family for the pooja, but Lavanya decides to spoil it.

episodesList.title: Lavanya suspects Khushi
episodesList.summary: Shyam tries to dissuade Madhumati from going to Raizada house but she is determined. Later, everybody is shocked when the police inform that Lavanya had called to verify Khushi's background. While Arnav sends the cops away, Nani apologises to Madhumati.

episodesList.title: Arnav attends the pooja
episodesList.summary: Khushi decides to continue with her job despite being insulted. She asks Arnav to stay back for the pooja, but he refuses. She asks Lavanya to convince him to attend the pooja with his family. Will Arnav attend the pooja?

episodesList.title: Arnav mistreats Khushi
episodesList.summary: Akash drops Buaji and Payal home after the pooja, but Khushi stays back. Nani asks Arnav to drop Khushi home. But they stop fighting on the way, and Arnav drops Khushi midway. He later returns to pick her up, but Khushi refuses to go with him. She reaches home exhausted, upset about Lavanya and Arnav's treatment.

episodesList.title: Khushi tries to cheer payal.
episodesList.summary: Payal is upset with Khushi and she tries to cheer her up by talking nonsense about Arnav. Later, Khushi tampers with Arnav's car and he is forced to arrange the meeting at home. Meanwhile, Khushi tries to explain the importance of marriage to Lavanya.

episodesList.title: Khushi bothers Arnav
episodesList.summary: Khushi bothers and embarrasses Arnav in front of his clients during the meeting. Arnav is clueless about the incident and the culprit, but soon realises it is Khushi and swears to take revenge. Meanwhile, Lavanya takes the responsibility of looking after Laxmi.

episodesList.title: Shyam to frame Khushi
episodesList.summary: Shyam steals Anjali's necklace in order to frame Khushi. Lavanya pampers Laxmi while Nani watches her. Meanwhile, Shyam reminds Anjali to wear the stolen necklace. Later, Arnav shouts at Khushi for playing pranks and she retaliates. He blames her for spoiling his laptop but Anjali takes the blame for it.

episodesList.title: Lavanya loses Lakshmi
episodesList.summary: Manorama asks Lavanya to take Laxmi for a walk. However, Laxmi gets lost. Meanwhile, an angry Khushi spills hot tea on Arnav. On the other hand, Manorama and Lavanya try to replace Laxmi with another goat. Khushi suggests them not to lie, but in vain. She then decides to look for Laxmi.

episodesList.title: Khushi wins over Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Khushi wins Lavanya's confidence by bringing Laxmi back and taking the blame of losing her. Shyam is happy as Anjali fails to find the necklace, but Nani stops Manorama from searching Khushi. However, Khushi empties her bag for her satisfaction.

episodesList.title: Shyam's plot fails
episodesList.summary: Nani finds Anjali's necklace on Laxmi's neck. Khushi explains the disadvantages of a live-in relationship to Lavanya. Meanwhile, Shyam is shocked to know that his scheme has failed. Later, Arnav is angry when he sees Lavanya dressed like Khushi.

episodesList.title: Lavanya proposes to Arnav
episodesList.summary: Nani refuses to let Lavanya stay with them any longer, but the latter shocks everybody by proposing to Arnav. Meanwhile, Khushi is surprised to see her parents. Later, Madhumati tells her parents about Shyam.

episodesList.title: Khushi avoids confrontation
episodesList.summary: Lavanya comes to office with Arnav's lunch, but he berates her for becoming like Khushi. Meanwhile, Khushi tries to console her father when he feels guilty for the financial crisis. Later, Khushi tries to avoid confrontation with Arnav. Madhumati discusses Shyam as a prospective groom for Khushi.

episodesList.title: Khushi insults Arnav
episodesList.summary: Arnav blocks Khushi's way and shouts at her. She insults him back. Meanwhile, the fuse goes off while Lavanya replaces a bulb. She fixes it herself to save Khushi. Later, Shashi shares his apprehensions about Shyam with Garima. Arnav becomes emotional about the time spent with his parents.

episodesList.title: Shashi doubts Shyam
episodesList.summary: Shashi reveals his doubts about Shyam to Garima. Meanwhile, Anjali is upset when Shyam tells her he will be late for her parents' death anniversary ceremony. Shashi overhears their conversation and asks Shyam about Anjali. Later, Khushi apologises to Arnav for her misbehaviour, but he shouts back.

episodesList.title: Shashi looks for Anjali's number
episodesList.summary: Arnav asks Khushi to leave the house. Anjali tries to console her while she misses her parents. Meanwhile, Shyam learns about Shashi's heart disease. Shashi tries to retrieve Anjali's number from Shyam's phone. Anjali is upset with Shyam for being late for the pooja.

episodesList.title: Arnav regrets his behaviour
episodesList.summary: Anjali is angry with Shyam for being late for the pooja. Payal assures Khushi about her father. Meanwhile, Arnav regrets his behaviour with Khushi and gets upset when she does not come for work. Shashi on the other hand, is suspicious about Shyam and enquires about his whereabouts when he comes home.

episodesList.title: Arnav learns to apologise
episodesList.summary: Shashi's suspicion grows when he learns about Shyam's absence from court. Arnav goes to the party when he learns that Khushi has accompanied Lavanya to the party. He apologises to Khushi for his rudeness. Later, after a conversation with Anjali, he realises how easy it is to apologise.

episodesList.title: Khushi helps Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Arnav's family is surprised to see him calm. Meanwhile, Khushi is overwhelmed with Arnav's apology. Later, Arnav disappoints Lavanya by speaking against marriage. Khushi however, dresses up Lavanya like a bride to impress Arnav. Shashi on the other hand, enquires about Shyam's background.

episodesList.title: Lavanya leaves the Raizada House
episodesList.summary: Arnav scolds Lavanya and Khushi, and makes it clear that he does not want to get married. Lavanya leaves the house and Arnav asks Khushi to quit her job. She tries to defend Lavanya and explain her view to Arnav. Will Arnav listen?

episodesList.title: Khushi tries to resolve the fight
episodesList.summary: Shyam avoids confrontation with Khushi. Lavanya tells Khushi about returning to London forever. Meanwhile, Anjali and Shyam try to change Arnav's view on marriage. Later, he scolds Khushi for disturbing him and tells her about his changed feelings for Lavanya. Shashi finally gets hold of Anjali's number.

episodesList.title: Lavanya comes to Raizada House
episodesList.summary: Lavanya comes back to Raizada house with Arnav. Anjali welcomes them, but Nani still disapproves of Lavanya. Later, Anjali asks Akash about his feelings for Payal. Meanwhile, Lavanya fails to impress Nani again.

episodesList.title: Khushi saves Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Nani is furious over shifting of the Tulsi plant, but Khushi puts the blame on Arnav to save Lavanya from Nani's anger. Meanwhile, Manorama explains the significance of Ashtami pooja to Lavanya and Nani gives her the responsibilities of the gifts. Later, Shyam hints Madhumati for Khushi and his marriage.

episodesList.title: The temple visit
episodesList.summary: Shyam bribes the priest before Anjali and her parents arrive. Anjali spots him near the temple, but he manages to escape again. Later, Arnav finds his project model broken and blames Khushi for it. How will Khushi react?

episodesList.title: Arnav gets dizzy
episodesList.summary: Arnav is angry on seeing the kids. Anjali informs him that she has invited them for pooja. Arnav calls Khushi, who is nervous about talking to him. While Shyam doubts Shashi, Lavanya tells Khushi that Arnav is going to Nainital. Meanwhile, Arnav feels dizzy while watering the plants.

episodesList.title: Khushi apologises To Arnav
episodesList.summary: Khushi tends to Arnav when she finds him. Payal invites Aakash to have tea with her parents. Meanwhile, Arnav laughs when Khushi apologises to him for being rude. Later, Lavanya tells Manorama about the allergy on her face.

episodesList.title: Arnav finds Khushi
episodesList.summary: Madhumati asks Shyam for his horoscope. While Arnav finds Khushi in the trunk of his car, Nani scolds Lavanya for trying to use holy water to wash her face. Meanwhile, Arnav's vehicle breaks down on the way to Nainital. He is annoyed when Khushi keeps talking throughout the way.

episodesList.title: Khushi has a fall
episodesList.summary: Shashi shows Shyam his driving licence and asks about the confusion over his date of birth. Khushi falls into a pit and Arnav finds her. Meanwhile, Manorama is shocked when she sees Akash lifting Payal. Later, Khushi's clothes are stolen and she gets stuck in the washroom.

episodesList.title: Payal rejects Akash's calls
episodesList.summary: Arnav and Khushi stop at a dhaba. Shashi informs the family that Khushi has gone to Nainital with Arnav. Akash calls up Payal to apologise but she rejects his call. Meanwhile, Arnav is irritated with Khushi and leaves her at the dhaba.

episodesList.title: Shashi exposes Shyam
episodesList.summary: While Shashi exposes Shyam, Khushi convinces Arnav not to leave her. Arnav asks her to leave before the next morning. But he later realises that she has fever. Meanwhile, Manorama talks to Anjali about Akash's interest in Payal. Later, Shashi follows Shyam and finds Anjali with him.

episodesList.title: Arnav hurts Khushi
episodesList.summary: While Arnav regrets his behaviour towards Khushi, Shashi threatens to expose Shyam in front of his family. When Shashi gets hysterical, Shyam stops him from taking his medicine. Meanwhile, some miscreants stop Khushi and Arnav. Arnav attacks them, but accidentally hurts Khushi.

episodesList.title: Shyam attempts murder
episodesList.summary: The doctor tells Shyam that Shashi's condition is critical. Payal informs Anjali about Shashi's condition. On reaching Delhi, Arnav gives Khushi some money and asks her to leave. While Akash is upset as Payal refuses to talk to him, Shyam disrupts Shashi's oxygen supply. Will he survive?

episodesList.title: Shashi is paralyzed
episodesList.summary: Anjali tells Arnav about Shashi's health condition. Shyam torments Shashi as he knows that he can't react. Khushi is sad and upset on seeing Shyam's condition. Meanwhile, Anjali tries to console Khushi's family.

episodesList.title: Shyam wants to marry Khushi
episodesList.summary: An emotional Khushi sees Arnav and begins to cry. Shyam tricks Madhumati and Garima into believing that Shashi wants him to marry Khushi. He tells them that he is willing to marry Khushi, but will never leave Anjali as he wants to be with both of them.

episodesList.title: Khushi's reluctance
episodesList.summary: Khushi learns that Arnav has cleared Shyam's hospital bills. Akash apologises to Payal on behalf of Manorama. Later, Madhumati talks to Khushi about her marriage with Shyam. However, Khushi isn't willing to marry him.

episodesList.title: Akash tells Anjali about Payal
episodesList.summary: Payal consoles Khushi as she worries about her marriage with Shyam. Akash tells Anjali about his feelings for Payal. Later, Khushi is upset as she fails to buy any silver or gold on Dhanteras. However, Arnav surprises her. How does he make Khushi happy?

episodesList.title: Khushi refuses to get engaged
episodesList.summary: Arnav helps Khushi untangle herself from the light wires. Meanwhile, Madhumati and Garima confirm Khushi’s engagement with Shyam. Later, while giving medicines to Shashi, Khushi tells him that she won’t marry Shyam. But Shyam overhears her conversation.

episodesList.title: Akash buys a diya for Payal
episodesList.summary: Khushi explains the significance of Diwali to Lavanya. She later seeks Arnav’s help to decorate the hall. Meanwhile, Akash gets a ‘diya’ for Payal. Later, Arnav and Khushi fall on the rangoli. Does Payal accept Akash’s gift?

episodesList.title: Khushi is in love with Arnav
episodesList.summary: Arnav is mesmerised when he sees Khushi in a saree. Khushi realises that she is in love with Arnav. She imagines herself and Arnav as a couple. Shyam tries to cheer her up by getting sweets and decorating the house. What makes Khushi realise her love for Arnav?

episodesList.title: Khushi rejects Shyam's proposal
episodesList.summary: Anjali asks Arnav why he is worried. Khushi makes Nani happy by telling her about her plans to make diyas. While Lavanya asks her to steal mud from Arnav's plants for the diyas, Madhumati is angry on learning that Khushi has rejected Shyam's proposal. What will Madhumati do now?

episodesList.title: Arnav finds Khushi's video
episodesList.summary: Khushi steals mud from Arnav’s plants. Instead of getting angry, he allows her to take it and even removes mud from her eyes. Khushi thinks Arnav is practising black magic. Later, Arnav is shocked to see Khushi's video on his laptop. What is the video about?

episodesList.title: Khushi punishes herself
episodesList.summary: Khushi apologises to Arnav for trying to spoil his throat and consumes the juice herself. Later, she receives Diwali gifts from Anjali. Meanwhile, Madhumati is emotional thinking about Shashi and requests Khushi to marry Shyam. Will Khushi change her mind?

episodesList.title: Arnav is mesmerized
episodesList.summary: Khushi’s family performs Diwali pooja with the Raizada family. Meanwhile, Shyam deliberately falls sick to avoid meeting Khushi. She and Nani are delighted to see Lavanya shout at her friends for making fun of Nani. Will Khushi learn about Shyam’s presence in the house?

episodesList.title: Nani has a wish
episodesList.summary: Nani praises Lavanya and tells her that she wishes her to marry Arnav. Khushi is unhappy when she hears this. Later, Khushi sprains her ankle and goes to Anjali’s room. Will she see Shyam in the room?

episodesList.title: Khushi wants answers from Arnav
episodesList.summary: Arnav and Khushi are lost in a moment of love. Khushi is curious to know how Arnav has her anklet. She tries to get him to answer all her questions, but fails to do so. Later, Arnav shocks her when he agrees to marry Lavanya in front of the guests. What is the reason behind his decision?

episodesList.title: Khushi congratulates Arnav
episodesList.summary: Everyone congratulates Arnav. He, however, stops Nani from fixing the marriage date. Later, while dropping Khushi, he brings up the topic of the anklet. Khushi tells him that he and Lavanya make a good pair. Arnav then asks her to step out of the car. Why does Arnav stop Nani from finalising the wedding date?

episodesList.title: Madhumati's request to Khushi
episodesList.summary: Madhumati welcomes Arnav to her house. Arnav tells Khushi that she doesn’t mean anything to him. Later, Madhumati screams on seeing Khushi and Shyam’s names written on the wall. She requests Khushi to marry Shyam. Will Khushi agree?

episodesList.title: Arnav thinks about Khushi
episodesList.summary: Madhumati and Garima are happy with Khushi’s decision to marry Shyam. Arnav recalls his past with Khushi and gets disturbed. What is the motive behind Shyam’s decision to marry Khushi?

episodesList.title: Khushi gets farewell gifts
episodesList.summary: Khushi visits the Raizada house on Anjali and Nani’s request. She overhears Arnav getting angry with Anjali for inviting her. Later, Nani, Anjali and Lavanya give farewell gifts to Khushi. But Arnav then asks her to leave the house. Why is Arnav hostile towards Khushi?

episodesList.title: Shashi gets the wrong medicine
episodesList.summary: Arnav feels guilty for being rude to Khushi. Shyam is angry for the delay in his engagement with Khushi. In a fit of rage, he puts Shashi’s life in danger, giving him the wrong medicine. Why doesn’t Shyam and Khushi’s engagement take place?

episodesList.title: Khushi is unhappy
episodesList.summary: Indira blames Khushi for Shashi’s condition and asks her to get engaged to Shyam immediately. Left with no choice, Khushi gets engaged to Shyam. He gives her a gift to cheer her up. Later, Anjali asks Shyam about his wedding ring. Will Anjali find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Anjali celebrates Bhaiduj
episodesList.summary: While celebrating Bhaiduj, Anjali shouts at Arnav for being rude to Khushi. While, Payal apologises to Akash for her behaviour, Lavanya and Nani hatch a plan to make Khushi stay back at the Raizada house. Will Khushi stay back despite Arnav’s rudeness?

episodesList.title: Arnav feels guilty
episodesList.summary: Arnav sees Khushi in the house and insults her for returning to the Raizada house. He and Khushi decide not to talk to each other. Meanwhile, Anjali informs Shyam about inviting Khushi for Arnav’s engagement. How will Shyam react to Khushi’s return to the Raizada house?

episodesList.title: Manorama asks Khushi to leave
episodesList.summary: Shyam jokes with Anjali about getting remarried. Later, Lavanya informs everyone that Arnav will not go to the office for some days. Meanwhile, Khushi tries to convey a message to Arnav, but fails to do so. Later, Manorama asks her to leave the house as Lavanya has learnt all the household chores.

episodesList.title: Arnav receives Khushi's note
episodesList.summary: Nani and Lavanya continue their fake fight to make Khushi stay. Manorama asks Khushi to meet her near the temple. Meanwhile, Arnav finds an old note written by Khushi. He saves her from falling into the pool. Later, Khushi deliberately disturbs him while he is on an important call and runs away.

episodesList.title: Akash proposes to Payal
episodesList.summary: Arnav does not talk to Khushi. Shyam tries to fix the marriage dates. Meanwhile, Akash surprises Payal by sending her a gift which she had desired, and proposes to her. Later, Khushi finds Arnav talking to the stars.

episodesList.title: Akash proposes to Payal
episodesList.summary: While Akash proposes to Payal, Arnav finds Khushi’s ring at the poolside, but fails to recognise it. Madhumati is shocked on learning about the ring and asks Khushi to look for it. Will Payal accept Akash’s proposal?

episodesList.title: Arnav learns about the engagement
episodesList.summary: Khushi learns about Nani and Lavanya’s fake fight. She later informs Shyam about losing the engagement ring. Arnav asks Khushi to apologise if she wants her ring back. She obliges and also tells him about her engagement. How will Arnav react?

episodesList.title: Arnav makes comparisons
episodesList.summary: Arnav is annoyed that Khushi kept her engagement a secret. He tries to physically hurt himself while talking to her. Lavanya asks Khushi to dress the wound. Arnav reluctantly congratulates Khushi and at the same time, insults her by comparing himself to her fiancé.

episodesList.title: Arnav talks about Khushi
episodesList.summary: Arnav tells Anjali that he suspects Khushi was forced to get engaged. He then informs everyone about his decision to advance his engagement with Lavanya. Meanwhile, Khushi grows suspicious about the voice she heard on Anjali’s phone. Is Arnav trying to play mind games with Khushi?

episodesList.title: Khushi's suspicion about Shyam
episodesList.summary: Lavanya is worried by her parents' absence at her engagement. Khushi is disinterested in Arnav's engagement and tells him that. Later, she asks Shyam about Arnav and Lavanya’s engagement. She grows suspicious of Shyam’s character.

episodesList.title: Arnav gifts a necklace to Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Payal lies to Khushi about her love for Akash. She is later shocked to see Akash at home. Meanwhile, Anjali and Lavanya are busy buying jewellery for the engagement. Later, Arnav tries to humiliate Khushi by gifting her favourite necklace to Lavanya.

episodesList.title: Anjali gets suspicious of Shyam
episodesList.summary: Anjali is shocked to learn about Shyam’s lie regarding the ring. Naani is curious on seeing her worried. While Lavanya forces Khushi to wear a wedding dress, Arnav humiliates Khushi again. What has Anjali learnt about Shyam?

episodesList.title: Arnav gets angry with Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Lavanya buys the dresses suggested by Khushi. Arnav scolds her for wearing a cheap dress. While Khushi tries to defend Lavanya, Manorama wants Akash to get engaged soon. Later, Akash asks Payal to meet him for the last time. Will he convince her to accept his proposal?

episodesList.title: Akash and Payal are seen together
episodesList.summary: While Shyam evades Anjali’s questions, Akash is excited about meeting Payal. Coincidentally, Arnav and Khushi also happen to meet each other in the same restaurant. They argue and then see Akash and Payal together.

episodesList.title: Arnav and Khushi decide to meet
episodesList.summary: Khushi and Arnav are shocked when they see Akash propose to Payal. Later at home, Arnav is surprised to see Akash in a sad mood. Khushi also sees Payal in a similar condition. Khushi then decides to meet Arnav in the same restaurant. Why does she want to meet him?

episodesList.title: Arnav-Khushi Hatch a Plan
episodesList.summary: Khushi and Arnav draw up a plan to reunite Akash and Payal. Although Payal finds out about their plan, Arnav assures Khushi of convincing Payal and Akash’s parents about their marriage. Will he keep his promise?

episodesList.title: Manorama refuses to accept Payal
episodesList.summary: Khushi assures Payal that Arnav will convince his parents. Everyone but Manorama agrees to the marriage. Khushi and Arnav then plan to have a second go at convincing Manorama again. Will they succeed?

episodesList.title: Manorama Accepts Payal
episodesList.summary: In order to stress her disapproval, Manorama pretends to leave the house. Arnav, however, convinces her to stay. Manorama agrees to the marriage, but with a condition. Everyone is happy as Akash thanks her for accepting Payal. But what is Manorama’s condition?

episodesList.title: Both the families are ready for Akash and Payal's marriage
episodesList.summary: Khushi informs Payal about the Raizada family's decision. Madhumati is amazed to see Raizada family arrive at their home. Shyam tries to hide away from the Raizada family. Both the families are gratified and are ready for Akash and Payal's marriage. Shashi is being introduced to the Raizada family. He starts to panic seeing Anjali’s face and tries to tell everyone about Shyam.

episodesList.title: Khushi punctures Arnav's tyre
episodesList.summary: While Shashi tries to tell to Anjali the truth about Shyam, the Raizadas wish to meet Khushi’s fiancé. Later, Payal thanks Arnav for helping her and Akash. Later, Arnav yells at Khushi for being unsure about her decisions. But Khushi retaliates and punctures his car tyre.

episodesList.title: Khushi gets suspicious of Shyam
episodesList.summary: Shashi’s feeble attempts to expose Shyam raise Khushi’s suspicions about the latter. Later, she overhears Shyam asking Akash about her being invited for the Satyanarayan puja. During the puja, she tries to recognise his face as he is sitting ahead of her. Will she manage to expose him?

episodesList.title: The truth about Shyam
episodesList.summary: Anjali is worried as Shyam is absent from the puja. Khushi leaves the puja to call him. Her doubts are cleared as the situation reminds her of a similar incident from the past. Disheartened, she breaks down in front of Arnav. Will she tell him the truth about Shyam?

episodesList.title: Khushi warns Shyam
episodesList.summary: Unaware of the truth, Anjali introduces Shyam to Khushi. Khushi is reminded of Shyam’s tricks in the past to fool her family. Later, on seeing Shyam, she warns him to stay away from her and her family. Shyam then apologises to her for his fraudulent ways. Will Shyam really mend his ways?

episodesList.title: Shyam threatens Khushi
episodesList.summary: Khushi is uncertain about how to deal with Shyam. Madhumati curses Shyam for playing with her emotions. Later, when Khushi decides to expose him, Shyam threatens to ruin Akash and Payal’s relationship.

episodesList.title: Arnav breaks up with Lavanya
episodesList.summary: On meeting Anjali, Khushi changes her mind about exposing Shyam. Arnav tells Lavanya that he has no feelings for her and decides to inform his family as well. How does Lavanya react to Arnav’s revelation about their relationship?

episodesList.title: Khushi refuses to expose Shyam
episodesList.summary: As Madhumati and Payal eagerly await the Raizada family’s decision about Shyam, Khushi informs them that she has not revealed the truth to the Raizadas. Payal then decides to forget about the past and focus on her engagement with Akash.

episodesList.title: Arnav and Lavanya are blessed
episodesList.summary: Arnav is sorry for breaking Lavanya's heart. Khushi threatens to expose Shyam before Anjali. Later, Nani introduces Shyam to Khushi's family. Madhumati rebukes Manorama. Meanwhile, Khushi wishes Arnav luck and congratulates Payal and Lavanya.

episodesList.title: Arnav declares his break up
episodesList.summary: Lavanya informs Khushi about her break-up and requests her to keep it a secret until Payal and Akash’s engagement. Meanwhile, Payal and Akash get engaged in a grand function. Arnav then informs everyone about his break-up with Lavanya.

episodesList.title: Lavanya defends Arnav
episodesList.summary: Khushi yells at Arnav for breaking up with Lavanya. She then tries to stop Lavanya from leaving the house. Nani asks Arnav to give a solid reason behind his decision and refuses to let Lavanya go. But Lavanya tells everyone that it was a mutual decision and bids them goodbye

episodesList.title: Anjali supports Arnav's break-up
episodesList.summary: Khushi decides never to speak about Shyam. At the Raizada house, Arnav gets full support from Anjali for his decision to break up with Lavanya. Later, Khushi is seen imitating Akash in the bathroom. Mistaking Arnav to be Payal, she pulls him inside the bathroom.

episodesList.title: Manorama welcomes Nanda Kishore
episodesList.summary: Khushi helps Anjali with the wedding arrangements. She notices Anjali ordering Shyam to change his white shirt. Shyam tells her that Anjali is ill-treating him. Meanwhile, Manorama is all excited to welcome their special guest from Sydney, Nanda Kishore.

episodesList.title: Arnav plans a cocktail party
episodesList.summary: Shyam requests Anjali to manage his daily expenses account. Meanwhile, Arnav announces a cocktail party for Akash and Payal. Khushi and Nanda Kishore wish to have desi entertainment at the party. Will Khushi learn about Shyam’s motives?

episodesList.title: No desi entertainment
episodesList.summary: Khushi is angry with Arnav for refusing to arrange desi entertainment for the cocktail party. Akash gives a letter for Payal to Khushi. Later, he arrives at their house to escort them for the party. Khushi doesn’t go to the party due to a sprained ankle. Later, she asks Nanda Kishore for a favour.

episodesList.title: Khushi dances with Nanda Kishore
episodesList.summary: Arnav is angry on learning that Khushi is Nanda Kishore’s date at the cocktail party. The guests are bored and Khushi taunts Arnav about it. Later, to infuse some life into the party, Khushi and Nanda Kishore perform a dance for the guests on a desi song.

episodesList.title: Arnav won't dance with Khushi
episodesList.summary: Arnav offers to drop Khushi home, but she goes with Nanda Kishore. Both families prepare for the Sangeet ceremony. At the Sangeet rehearsal, Anjali introduces Khushi and Payal to the choreographer hired for the ceremony. The choreographer pairs Khushi with Arnav, but Arnav refuses to dance with her.

episodesList.title: Shyam tries to brainwash Khushi
episodesList.summary: Khushi and Nanda Kishore have a hard time syncing their steps. Shyam also joins the dance rehearsal and tries poisoning Khushi’s mind against Anjali. Madhumati pulls out her wedding dress for Khushi. Later, Khushi irritates Arnav by using Nanda Kishore as her weapon.

episodesList.title: Nanda Kishore's belief
episodesList.summary: The choreographer Madhubala once again asks Arnav and Khushi to dance together, but they refuse. She then asks the elders from the both the families to dance, too. Meanwhile, Shyam is plans to earn Khushi’s trust. Nanda Kishore shares his belief about meeting your lover on New Year’s night.

episodesList.title: Arnav hears Khushi chat
episodesList.summary: Madhumati asks Khushi to wear her old wedding dress on the wedding day. She and Garima then discuss what to gift the groom’s family. Anjali refuses dance as she is unwell and informs Shyam. Later, Arnav finds Nanda Kishore chatting with Khushi over the phone.

episodesList.title: Khushi vows not to look at Arnav
episodesList.summary: Nanda Kishore comes up with a plan for Akash and Payal to meet at midnight on New Year’s. Akash asks Arnav to accompany him, but in vain. Khushi vows to not see Arnav’s face at midnight because of Nanda Kishore’s romantic belief.

episodesList.title: Akash hides from Madhumati
episodesList.summary: After failing to bring Payal out of the house, Akash sneaks into the house to see her at midnight. In order to hide from Madhumati, he hides under the table. Meanwhile, Shyam plans to kill Anjali by electrocuting her. He brings her to the edge of the pool to push her into the water.

episodesList.title: Manorama's husband saves Anjali
episodesList.summary: Manorama's husband saves Anjali before Shyam could push her into the pool. Payal tries to hide Akash from Madhumati while he is stuck to a chair. Arnav goes to Madhumati's house to help Akash get out of the sticky situation. Nanda Kishore plans to sneak out of the Raizada house to see Khushi at midnight. Akash persuades Payal to come out with him to celebrate New Year. Arnav goes back to Madhumati's house to look for his mobile phone. As clock hits 12 Khushi switches on the light and sees Arnav on New Year's night

episodesList.title: Arnav hides in Khushi's room
episodesList.summary: Khushi yells at Arnav for ruining her New Year’s Eve. Arnav asks her to keep quiet lest she wake up the entire family. Nanda Kishore knocks on Khushi’s door to greet her, but Madhumati opens the door. In order to hide from Madhumati, Arnav lies down on Khushi’s bed pretending to be Payal.

episodesList.title: Arnav and Khushi's accusations
episodesList.summary: Arnav and Khushi blame each other for the unplanned meeting. Later, Arnav and Akash confront Nanda Kishore for sneaking into Khushi’s house at midnight. While Anjali looks at Shyam’s face at midnight, Shyam stares at Khushi’s picture.

episodesList.title: Cancelling of the Sangeet
episodesList.summary: Khushi vows to defeat the Raizadas at the Sangeet. She notices a mosquito sitting on Arnav's face when he is talking to Nand Kishore about the sangeeth and slaps him to kill the mosquito. Arnav gets angry and cancels the dance competition. Khushi tries to explain. Will Arnav change his mind?

episodesList.title: Arnav gives his nod
episodesList.summary: Arnav informs Khushi that he cancelled the Sangeet because he doesn't like the loud noise. In return, Khushi and the entire family start talking in sign language. Arnav, then, assumes that Anjali skips her lunch because she is sad about the Sangeeth being cancelled. He goes to her room and sees her having her lunch. How will he react?

episodesList.title: The challenge
episodesList.summary: Nani declares that the winner will get a forty-year-old Natraj idol as the award. Khushi and Arnav vow to defeat each other. While practicing for the competition, Madhumati catches Shyam secretly looking at Khushi. She confronts him. Arnav gets angry on seeing Nand Kishore calling up Khushi to chat with her. Will Shyam mend his ways?

episodesList.title: Khushi impersonates Manorama and Madhumati
episodesList.summary: Manorama claims that Payal had not only stolen Akash from her but also her position as the daughter-in-law of the Raizada family. Akash reassures her that he will always be her son. Payal is worried that Manorama will ill treat her after marriage. Khushi impersonates Manorama and Madhumati to cheer up Payal. Raizada family goes to Payal's house. Arnav is amused to see Khushi dressed like Manorama. Arnav and Khushi argue about who will win the dance competition.

episodesList.title: Shyam and the scorpion
episodesList.summary: Manorama insults Madhumati for gifting a silver puja plate to Anjali. Akash, however, praises Madhumati for the same. Payal gets worried about Manorama’s dislike towards her, but Khushi reassures her. Shyam hides a poisonous scorpion in a sweet box in a move to kill Anjali. Will the scorpion sting Anjali?

episodesList.title: Sangeet Ceremony Begins
episodesList.summary: Bua and Khushi are seen pushing a box somewhere with costumes for their dances. Arnav and Khushi taunt each other about the challenge. Shyam is worried about the box. Nani and NK give an intimidating performance.

episodesList.title: Manorama cheats in the dance competition
episodesList.summary: Shyam finds the sweet box that contains the poisonous scorpion in the kitchen. To defeat Madhumati in the dance competition, Manorama mixes liquor in the juice. After consuming the doctored juice, Madhumati gets dizzy and forgets the dance steps on the stage. Khushi is distressed when Manorama scores high points and puts the Raizada family in the lead. Arnav is pleased to see the Gupta family lagging behind.

episodesList.title: Khushi pokes Arnav
episodesList.summary: Nand Kishore boosts Khushi’s confidence, but Arnav taunts her for being nervous. Manorama insults Payal in front of all the guests. Khushi gives a great performance and is praised by all. She makes fun of Arnav on the stage. How does Arnav react?

episodesList.title: Shyam's threat to Khushi
episodesList.summary: Arnav taunts Khushi. Shyam threatens Khushi for rejecting his love. Arnav thinks Khushi is crying to gain his sympathy. Madhumati confronts Manorama for lacing her drink with alcohol. Khushi’s dance partner ditches her and she doesn't have a partner. What will Khushi do?

episodesList.title: Arnav dances with Khushi
episodesList.summary: The Raizadas and the Guptas are stunned to see Arnav volunteering to dance with Khushi. The couple's performance leaves everyone speechless. Manorama and Shyam do not like Arnav and Khushi’s closeness. Shyam yells at Nand Kishore for praising Khushi and Arnav’s pair. Will the dance performance bring Arnav and Khushi closer?

episodesList.title: Khushi wins
episodesList.summary: Khushi thanks Arnav for dancing with her and gets flustered when he compliments her. Khushi receives the gold Nataraj idol for best performance. Shyam is displeased to see Arnav and Khushi together. He puts the scorpion on Anjali's bed in a bid to kill her. Will Anjali see the scorpion?

episodesList.title: Arnav tries to protect Anjali
episodesList.summary: Arnav becomes overprotective about Anjali after the scorpion incident. He asks her to conduct the Mehendi rasam at Raizada house. Akash sneaks into the room where the rasam is happening to get a glimpse of Payal. Nand Kishore also participates in the function in disguise. Does Nand Kishore get caught?

episodesList.title: Khushi is branded
episodesList.summary: Nand Kishore blames Arnav for getting caught. Anjali arranges for an exclusive mehendi designer for Payal. Manorama demands to get her mehendi done first. Arnav’s name gets written on Khushi’s hand by mistake. Nani gives a grand red saree and the family bridal necklace to Payal. Manorama gets disheartened on seeing it.

episodesList.title: Khushi gets a kiss challenge from Arnav
episodesList.summary: Khushi and Anjali berate Arnav for disappearing all of a sudden. Payal serves tea to Manorama in her room. Manorama warns her to be ready for a life of servitude to her after marriage. Khushi tries to get rid off the alphabet 'A' written on her hand. Arnav listens to Khushi's apologetic message in his voice mail. He sees the 'A' written on her hand and questions her. Khushi drops Payal's bangle in the pool and tries retrieving it. Arnav kisses Khushi and challenges her to kiss him back.

episodesList.title: Anjali's perfume mixing
episodesList.summary: Anjali sees the letter 'A' on Khushi’s hand and plots with Nani to bring Arnav and Khushi close. Madhumati sends Khushi to the Raizada house to deliver Akash’s suit. Khushi flirts with Nand Kishore to make Arnav jealous. Shyam sets another death trap for Anjali. What is Shyam’s latest move against Anjali?

episodesList.title: Arnav gets jealous
episodesList.summary: Nani and Anjali are happy to see Arnav and Khushi having feelings for each other. They act as though they are matchmaking for Khushi and Nand Kishore, to make Arnav jealous. Shashi blesses Payal with his paralysed hand and surprises everyone. Shyam makes another attempt to kill Anjali. What does he do?

episodesList.title: Arnav sees an accident
episodesList.summary: Anjali and Nani successfully fuel Arnav’s feelings for Khushi. Arnav goes in search of Khushi. On the way, he sees an accident and learns about a man and woman being injured. He also happens to see Khushi’s bangles and footwear on the road. Did Khushi meet with an accident?

episodesList.title: Arnav gets worried
episodesList.summary: Nani threatens to break all ties with the Raizada family and forces Manorama to accept Payal as her daughter-in-law. Arnav is relieved on finding Khushi safe. He panics on seeing her injured. Akash apologises to Payal for hiding the truth about her broken wedding from Manorama. Will Arnav reveal his feelings to Khushi?

episodesList.title: Arnav buys bangles
episodesList.summary: Arnav bandages Khushi’s wounds. Shyam gets displeased on learning that Arnav and Khushi came home together. Anjali and Nani are delighted about the same. Khushi sees the bangles bought by Arnav and faints. Why does Khushi faint?

episodesList.title: Arnav's Admission
episodesList.summary: Arnav is happy on seeing Khushi wearing the bangles that he had bought. He refuses to admit that he bought the pair. Khushi tells Anjali that she dislikes the bangles, to make him admit he bought them. Manorama taunts the Gupta family about not making any wedding arrangements. What is Khushi's reaction to Arnav's confession?

episodesList.title: Arnav realises his love
episodesList.summary: Arnav plans to deliver the bride’s clothes in order to meet Khushi. Upon meeting, Arnav and Khushi share a romantic moment and get lost in each other. Meanwhile, Shyam cuts the brake wire of Anjali’s car. Will Anjali be lucky to avert the ill-fate this time around?

episodesList.title: Khushi packs Payal's things
episodesList.summary: Khushi is surprised to see Arnav help her serve food to the guests. She then takes her relatives to Raizada house and introduces them to Nani. Later, she packs a few memorable things for Payal to take with her. On the other side, Shyam is expectantly awaiting Anjali’s death. Will Arnav propose to Khushi?

episodesList.title: Anjali's car goes out of control
episodesList.summary: Payal gets emotional on seeing the memorable things packed by Khushi. Khushi wipes her tears with the handkerchief offered by Arnav and returns it to him. Arnav tries speaking with Khushi alone but Shyam interrupts them. Shyam rehearses grieving for Anjali’s death. Nani calls up Anjali and asks her to return home soon. Anjali panics as the car goes out of control due to brake failure. Khushi keeps the bindi that Arnav had stuck on the mirror.

episodesList.title: Anjali comes to home injured
episodesList.summary: Manorama insults the Gupta family. Akash panics when Nandkishore talks about his life after marriage. Nani gets anxious about Anjali and informs Arnav about it. Shyam anticipates Anjali's death and makes arrangements for her funeral. Arnav learns about Anjali's accident from police and rushes to the spot but he receives an injured Anjali near the door. Anjali informs about the accident and requests not to tell Shyam, Akash and Gupta family. Arnav cries for Anjali even though she is fine.

episodesList.title: Shyam manhandles Khushi
episodesList.summary: Arnav tends to Anjali’s injuries. He then decides to profess his love to Khushi. Meanwhile, Khushi reads a message on the mirror and goes to the terrace to meet Arnav. To her surprise, she finds Shyam, who forcefully embraces her as she tries to run away. Arnav notices this. How will he react?

episodesList.title: Anjali stays alive
episodesList.summary: Arnav is devastated to see Shyam profess his love to Khushi. Khushi warns Shyam to stay away. Later, Shyam is shocked on learning that Anjali is alive. Meanwhile, Arnav decides to tell Anjali the truth about Shyam and Khushi. Shyam shamelessly challenges him to do so.

episodesList.title: Arnav discloses Shyam's truth
episodesList.summary: Shyam dares Arnav to tell the truth to Anjali. But just as Arnav prepares to do so, Anjali faints. Meanwhile, Khushi is looking for Arnav to tell him the truth about Shyam. Later, Shyam is worried about Arnav revealing the truth to Anjali.

episodesList.title: Khushi changes her mind
episodesList.summary: Anjali shares the news of her pregnancy with Shyam and Arnav. Shyam pretends to care for her and the baby. Meanwhile, Khushi changes her mind about informing Arnav about Shyam. Akash and Payal on the other hand, get ready for their wedding. Why does Khushi change her mind suddenly?

episodesList.title: Akash and Payal get married
episodesList.summary: Upon Arnav’s arrival, Payal and Akash exchange garlands. Arnav threatens to stop the wedding if Khushi doesn’t obey him. Khushi agrees and the ceremony proceeds smoothly. Manorama unwillingly welcomes Payal into the house. Meanwhile, Shyam gets suspicious on seeing their grim faces.

episodesList.title: Arnav marries Khushi
episodesList.summary: Everyone is shocked on seeing Arnav and Khushi as the newly-wed couple. Anjali and Nani demand an explanation for their sudden wedding. But Arnav and Khushi remain silent. What is the secret behind their secret wedding?

episodesList.title: Khushi is insulted by all
episodesList.summary: Arnav refuses to answer any questions and locks himself in his room. He orders Khushi to stay in his house for six months as his wife. Manorama insults the Gupta family for Khush’s actions. Nani and Anjali also berate her for demeaning the sanctity of marriage. Will Khushi reveal the truth to everyone?

episodesList.title: Arnav warns Shyam to be away from Khushi
episodesList.summary: Madhumati taunts Khushi for repaying the kindness with humiliation. Payal disowns Khushi for humiliating their family and refusing to give a reason for her actions. Raizada family is desolate after the wedding ceremony. Khushi tells Arnav that he has made her an orphan once again by forcing her to marry him. She demands to know why he had married her. Arnav refuses to answer her questions. Arnav warns Shyam not to go near Khushi now as she is his wife.

episodesList.title: Nani falls sick
episodesList.summary: Payal distributes puja prasadh to everyone except Khushi. Manorama taunts them. Shyam confronts Khushi for betraying him by marrying Arnav. Nani falls sick. Anjali blames Arnav for Nani's illness. Nani refuses to talk to Khushi. Arnav threatens to leave Raizada's house with Khushi if his family does not accept their marriage. Nani rejects the food prepared by Khushi. Anjali and Nani decide not to forgive Arnav for humiliating their family.

episodesList.title: Anjali asks Khushi to perform the rituals as per Raizada's custom
episodesList.summary: Anjali calls a family meeting and announces that Khushi will not be accepted as a daughter-in-law of the Raizada family until the ritual is performed as per the custom. She gives bridal dress and jewellery to Khushi and instructs her to get ready. Khushi recalls her dreams about her wedding. She thinks of the reality and cries. Anjali welcomes Arnav and Khushi while Manorama and Shyam fume in anger. Arnav is forced to carry Khushi into the house. Khushi's earring gets stuck in his coat

episodesList.title: Pretending to be happy
episodesList.summary: Anjali takes Khushi to Arnav’s room. Arnav instructs her to look happy in front of his family. Later, he sees Khushi shivering in cold weather and offers her a blanket. In the morning, Anjali takes Khushi to the kitchen, to which Manorama objects. Will the Raizadas accept Khushi?

episodesList.title: Khushi fights with Arnav
episodesList.summary: Khushi fights with Arnav for subjecting her to such misery. Arnav feels sad to see her being ignored by her family and insulted by Manorama. Meanwhile, Nani lets Khushi be a part of the family function despite Manorama’s disapproval. Later, Khushi demands the truth from Arnav.

episodesList.title: Arnav insults the guests
episodesList.summary: When Khushi’s dress is spoiled, she wears Arnav’s shirt, which also gets torn off. Meanwhile, Arnav finds Manorama spying on them and pretends to romance with Khushi. Later at the party, Arnav insults the guests for gossiping about him and Khushi. Will there be an end to Khushi’s miseries?

episodesList.title: Madhumati takes Payal home
episodesList.summary: Khushi tries to cheer up Payal, but fails to do so. She then tries to find solace in Nani’s pet goat, Lakshmi. Later, Madhumati arrives at the Raizada house to invite Payal for the rituals. However, she ignores Khushi. Anjali then asks Arnav to drop Khushi to Madhumati’s house for the ritual. Will Arnav agree?

episodesList.title: Arnav searches for Khushi
episodesList.summary: At Madhumati’s house, Khushi apologises to everyone. But Madhumati throws her out of the house. Khushi goes to the temple for refuge. Meanwhile, Payal calls up Arnav to enquire about Khushi. Arnav soon realises that Khushi is missing and sets out to search her. Will he be able to find her?

episodesList.title: Arnav confronts Khushi
episodesList.summary: Arnav forcefully brings Khushi home and warns her not to step out of the house without informing him. Meanwhile, Akash tells Anjali that Khushi wasn’t allowed to perform the Bakh Pheri Rasam. Later, Arnav confronts Khushi for hurting him. In retaliation, Khushi decides to learn the truth from Arnav.

episodesList.title: Khushi's Decision Shocks Arnav
episodesList.summary: Shyam is relieved to know that Anjali did not hear his conversation. Meanwhile, Khushi shocks Arnav, Buaji and Payal by deciding to relocate to Lucknow. Naani on the other hand, approves of Arnav and Lavanya's live-in relationship. Arnav is concerned about Khushi, but hides it from Lavanya.

episodesList.title: Lavanya Consoles Arnav
episodesList.summary: Khushi and Arnav keep thinking about each other. Anjali questions Arnav about his relationship with Lavanya. Meanwhile, Khushi is shocked to learn about Shashi's financial crisis, but Buaji consoles her and asks her to look for a job in Delhi. Later, Lavanya tries to cheer Arnav on seeing him disturbed.

episodesList.title: Nani Lays Down Rules for Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Khushi requests Shyam to help her look for a job. Meanwhile, Nani is unhappy to see Lavanya come home. She refuses to let her to stay in Arnav's room. This upsets Arnav and he threatens to leave the house. However, Shyam consoles him and asks him to consider Nani's decision.

episodesList.title: Manorama Warns Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Anjali asks Nani to give Lavanya a chance to prove herself. Lavanya is shocked to know that Nani plans to test her. Arnav is angry when Nani questions Lavanya on her cooking skills. On the other hand, Khushi and Payal decide to leave for Lucknow. However, Anjali's decision to meet Khushi shocks Arnav and Shyam.

episodesList.title: Nani Allots Task to Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Khushi is in a dilemma about leaving Delhi. Lavanya is shocked when Nani asks her to prepare dinner. Meanwhile, Shyam decides to meet Khushi. Arnav on the other hand, also keeps thinking about Khushi.

episodesList.title: Arnav and Anjali Meet Shyam
episodesList.summary: Shyam is shocked to see Anjali and Arnav, but lies to them when Anjali questions him. Meanwhile, Lavanya and Manorama are disastrous in kitchen. Khushi is touched when Buaji gives her jalebis for the journey, but an idea strikes her and she convinces them about it. She opens a sweet shop in front of their house.

episodesList.title: Khushi Sets Up a Sweet Shop
episodesList.summary: Manorama and Lavanya are tired preparing dinner. On the other hand, Khushi, Payal and Madhumati set up shop and wait for customers. Meanwhile, Nani doubts Lavanya's cooking skills and Manorama reveals the truth about the dinner preparation. Nani and Arnav are upset with Lavanya's lie.

episodesList.title: Khushi's Business in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Payal and Buaji are worried about Khushi's failing business, but she asks them to have faith. Nani warns everybody against helping Lavanya with her tasks. While, Anjali is surprised to see Shyam worried, Arnav continues thinking about Khushi. Later, Nani sees Lavanya going into Arnav's room.

episodesList.title: Khushi's New Idea
episodesList.summary: Nani asks Lavanya to leave Arnav's room. Shyam is relieved to know that Khushi is still in Delhi. The next morning, Manorama wakes up Lavanya and asks her attend the aarti. Meanwhile, Khushi decides to distribute sweets to the nearby hotels to help her get orders.

episodesList.title: Khushi Gets Order for Sweets
episodesList.summary: Nani scolds Lavanya and asks her to leave. Payal and Khushi worry when they fail to get orders, but are delighted when they get to deliver sweets to a high profile party. Meanwhile, Arnav is furious with himself for continually thinking about Khushi and decides to forget her.

episodesList.title: Khushi Is Stunned to Learn About Her First Client
episodesList.summary: Arnav and Nani decide to keep their differences aside during Anjali and Shyam?s anniversary party. Payal and Khushi are elated as they finish preparing the sweets for the party. Anjali is delighted to see the surprise Shyam plans for her. Khushi is shell-shocked to learn from the manager that she needs to deliver the sweets to Raizada house. Payal talks sense into Khushi and requests her to complete the order so that they can get back Madhumati's bangles from the pawn shop. Nani is furious when Lavanya drops the sweet dish which she had prepared for Shyam. Khushi realises the problems at home and decides to deliver the sweets to Arnav?s house. Khushi is scared to enter Arnav?s house.

episodesList.title: Khushi Wants to See Anjali's Beau
episodesList.summary: Arnav is shocked to find Khushi in his cupboard. However, Anjali tells him about Khushi getting the contract for the sweets. Khushi fails to see Shyam, but is insulted by Arnav. Later, Shyam is astonished to see Khushi in the party.

episodesList.title: Manorama Spoils the Sweets
episodesList.summary: Nani disapproves of Lavanya's dance performance and complains to Anjali. While a frustrated Lavanya drinks, Shyam escapes the party. Meanwhile, Khushi consoles Anjali. In the meantime, Manorama spoils the sweets, forcing the manager to cancel Khushi's contract.

episodesList.title: Lavanya Insults Nani
episodesList.summary: Manorama tries to poison Nani and Anjali against Khushi, but they support her and ask her serve the sweets to the guests. Meanwhile, a drunk Lavanya insults Nani, prompting Arnav to ask her to apologise. Nani scolds Manorama for supporting Lavanya. Later, Madhumati is shocked to hear about the spoilt sweets.

episodesList.title: Anjali and Manorama Meet Khushi
episodesList.summary: Lavanya apologises for insulting Nani and for spoiling the party. The contractor refuses to pay Khushi. On the other hand, Shyam tries to convince Khushi to go back to Lucknow. However, he leaves Khushi's house when he sees Anjali coming.

episodesList.title: Anjali Asks for Khushi's Help
episodesList.summary: Anjali asks Khushi to train Lavanya, but she declines the offer stating Arnav's presence as the reason. She tells Khushi that as per the terms, she has to pay them if she breaches the contract. Anjali leaves the decision to her. Later, Shyam offers help with the money to be paid to Anjali.

episodesList.title: Khushi Accepts Anjali's Offer
episodesList.summary: Shyam tries to convince Khushi against accepting Anjali's offer. Nani is upset with Lavanya and wishes to see a girl like Khushi in the house. She comes to Raizada house while Anjali and Manorama talk about her. However, Lavanya opposes Khushi's presence in the house and decides to leave.

episodesList.title: Khushi Starts Training Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Khushi convinces Nani about training Lavanya. Nani talks to Laxmi about her plan with Khushi. Meanwhile, Anjali asks Khushi to tie rakhi to Shyam. Later, she teaches Lavanya to make ginger tea and snacks. Anjali asks them to prepare dinner. Arnav asks Khushi to leave on seeing her in the kitchen.

episodesList.title: Arnav Upsets Anjali
episodesList.summary: Arnav misbehaves with Anjali when he learns that she had asked Khushi to come. He insults Khushi and asks her to leave. Anjali is upset with Arnav, who leaves house feeling guilty. However, he then goes to Khushi's house and pays her to do Anjali's work.

episodesList.title: Arnav and Khushi Look for Anjali
episodesList.summary: Anjali goes missing. Nani asks Arnav and Khushi to look for her when they come home. However, Arnav blames Khushi for the troubles. He finally finds Anjali in a temple and apologises for being rude. Later, Anjali calls Shyam and tells him that Khushi is waiting for him to tie the rakhi.

episodesList.title: Lavanya's Explanation
episodesList.summary: Lavanya explains the idea of a live-in relationship to Khushi. Meanwhile, Arnav asks Lavanya to choose between house and office. On the other hand, Shyam fails to provoke Khushi against the Raizada to keep her away from them.

episodesList.title: Khushi to Avoid Arnav
episodesList.summary: Shyam pretends to be innocent in front of Anjali and her family. Khushi thinks about Arnav and Lavanya's relationship. Lavanya on the other hand tells Arnav about Khushi's decision. Later, Anjali asks Khushi to explain Janmashtami to Lavanya.

episodesList.title: Khushi's Family Is Invited
episodesList.summary: Khushi narrates the story of Lord Krishna and everybody gets carried away by it. Arnav humiliates Khushi again, but Nani supports her and asks him to behave. Later, Nani invites Khushi's family for the pooja, but Lavanya decides to spoil it.

episodesList.title: Lavanya Suspects Khushi
episodesList.summary: Shyam tries to dissuade Madhumati from going to Raizada house but she is determined. Later, everybody is shocked when the police inform that Lavanya had called to verify Khushi's background. While Arnav sends the cops away, Nani apologises to Madhumati.

episodesList.title: Arnav Attends the Pooja
episodesList.summary: Khushi decides to continue with her job despite being insulted. She asks Arnav to stay back for the pooja, but he refuses. She asks Lavanya to convince him to attend the pooja with his family. Will Arnav attend the pooja?

episodesList.title: Arnav Mistreats Khushi
episodesList.summary: Akash drops Buaji and Payal home after the pooja, but Khushi stays back. Nani asks Arnav to drop Khushi home. But they stop fighting on the way, and Arnav drops Khushi midway. He later returns to pick her up, but Khushi refuses to go with him. She reaches home exhausted, upset about Lavanya and Arnav's treatment.

episodesList.title: Khushi Tries to Cheer Payal
episodesList.summary: Payal is upset with Khushi and she tries to cheer her up by talking nonsense about Arnav. Later, Khushi tampers with Arnav's car and he is forced to arrange the meeting at home. Meanwhile, Khushi tries to explain the importance of marriage to Lavanya.

episodesList.title: Khushi Bothers Arnav
episodesList.summary: Khushi bothers and embarrasses Arnav in front of his clients during the meeting. Arnav is clueless about the incident and the culprit, but soon realises it is Khushi and swears to take revenge. Meanwhile, Lavanya takes the responsibility of looking after Laxmi.

episodesList.title: Shyam to Frame Khushi
episodesList.summary: Shyam steals Anjali's necklace in order to frame Khushi. Lavanya pampers Laxmi while Nani watches her. Meanwhile, Shyam reminds Anjali to wear the stolen necklace. Later, Arnav shouts at Khushi for playing pranks and she retaliates. He blames her for spoiling his laptop but Anjali takes the blame for it.

episodesList.title: Lavanya Loses Lakshmi
episodesList.summary: Manorama asks Lavanya to take Laxmi for a walk. However, Laxmi gets lost. Meanwhile, an angry Khushi spills hot tea on Arnav. On the other hand, Manorama and Lavanya try to replace Laxmi with another goat. Khushi suggests them not to lie, but in vain. She then decides to look for Laxmi.

episodesList.title: Khushi Wins Over Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Khushi wins Lavanya's confidence by bringing Laxmi back and taking the blame of losing her. Shyam is happy as Anjali fails to find the necklace, but Nani stops Manorama from searching Khushi. However, Khushi empties her bag for her satisfaction.

episodesList.title: Shyam's Plot Fails
episodesList.summary: Nani finds Anjali's necklace on Laxmi's neck. Khushi explains the disadvantages of a live-in relationship to Lavanya. Meanwhile, Shyam is shocked to know that his scheme has failed. Later, Arnav is angry when he sees Lavanya dressed like Khushi.

episodesList.title: Lavanya Proposes to Arnav
episodesList.summary: Nani refuses to let Lavanya stay with them any longer, but the latter shocks everybody by proposing to Arnav. Meanwhile, Khushi is surprised to see her parents. Later, Madhumati tells her parents about Shyam.

episodesList.title: Khushi Avoids Confrontation
episodesList.summary: Lavanya comes to office with Arnav's lunch, but he berates her for becoming like Khushi. Meanwhile, Khushi tries to console her father when he feels guilty for the financial crisis. Later, Khushi tries to avoid confrontation with Arnav. Madhumati discusses Shyam as a prospective groom for Khushi.

episodesList.title: Khushi Insults Arnav
episodesList.summary: Arnav blocks Khushi's way and shouts at her. She insults him back. Meanwhile, the fuse goes off while Lavanya replaces a bulb. She fixes it herself to save Khushi. Later, Shashi shares his apprehensions about Shyam with Garima. Arnav becomes emotional about the time spent with his parents.

episodesList.title: Shashi Doubts Shyam
episodesList.summary: Shashi reveals his doubts about Shyam to Garima. Meanwhile, Anjali is upset when Shyam tells her he will be late for her parents' death anniversary ceremony. Shashi overhears their conversation and asks Shyam about Anjali. Later, Khushi apologises to Arnav for her misbehaviour, but he shouts back.

episodesList.title: Shashi Looks for Anjali's Number
episodesList.summary: Arnav asks Khushi to leave the house. Anjali tries to console her while she misses her parents. Meanwhile, Shyam learns about Shashi's heart disease. Shashi tries to retrieve Anjali's number from Shyam's phone. Anjali is upset with Shyam for being late for the pooja.

episodesList.title: Arnav Regrets His Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Anjali is angry with Shyam for being late for the pooja. Payal assures Khushi about her father. Meanwhile, Arnav regrets his behaviour with Khushi and gets upset when she does not come for work. Shashi on the other hand, is suspicious about Shyam and enquires about his whereabouts when he comes home.

episodesList.title: Arnav Learns to Apologise
episodesList.summary: Shahi's suspicion grows when he learns about Shyam's absence from court. Arnav goes to the party when he learns that Khushi has accompanied Lavanya to the party. He apologises to Khushi for his rudeness. Later, after a conversation with Anjali, he realises how easy it is to apologise.

episodesList.title: Khushi Helps Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Arnav's family is surprised to see him calm. Meanwhile, Khushi is overwhelmed with Arnav's apology. Later, Arnav disappoints Lavanya by speaking against marriage. Khushi however, dresses up Lavanya like a bride to impress Arnav. Shashi on the other hand, enquires about Shyam's background.

episodesList.title: Lavanya Leaves the Raizada House
episodesList.summary: Arnav scolds Lavanya and Khushi, and makes it clear that he does not want to get married. Lavanya leaves the house and Arnav asks Khushi to quit her job. She tries to defend Lavanya and explain her view to Arnav. Will Arnav listen?

episodesList.title: Khushi Tries to Resolve the Fight
episodesList.summary: Shyam avoids confrontation with Khushi. Lavanya tells Khushi about returning to London forever. Meanwhile, Anjali and Shyam try to change Arnav's view on marriage. Later, he scolds Khushi for disturbing him and tells her about his changed feelings for Lavanya. Shashi finally gets hold of Anjali's number.

episodesList.title: Lavanya Comes to Raizada House
episodesList.summary: Lavanya comes back to Raizada house with Arnav. Anjali welcomes them, but Nani still disapproves of Lavanya. Later, Anjali asks Akash about his feelings for Payal. Meanwhile, Lavanya fails to impress Nani again.

episodesList.title: Khushi Saves Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Nani is furious over shifting of the Tulsi plant, but Khushi puts the blame on Arnav to save Lavanya from Nani's anger. Meanwhile, Manorama explains the significance of Ashtami pooja to Lavanya and Nani gives her the responsibilities of the gifts. Later, Shyam hints Madhumati for Khushi and his marriage.

episodesList.title: The Temple Visit
episodesList.summary: Shyam bribes the priest before Anjali and her parents arrive. Anjali spots him near the temple, but he manages to escape again. Later, Arnav finds his project model broken and blames Khushi for it. How will Khushi react?

episodesList.title: Arnav Gets Dizzy
episodesList.summary: Arnav is angry on seeing the kids. Anjali informs him that she has invited them for pooja. Arnav calls Khushi, who is nervous about talking to him. While Shyam doubts Shashi, Lavanya tells Khushi that Arnav is going to Nainital. Meanwhile, Arnav feels dizzy while watering the plants.

episodesList.title: Khushi Apologises to Arnav
episodesList.summary: Khushi tends to Arnav when she finds him. Payal invites Aakash to have tea with her parents. Meanwhile, Arnav laughs when Khushi apologises to him for being rude. Later, Lavanya tells Manorama about the allergy on her face.

episodesList.title: Arnav Finds Khushi
episodesList.summary: Madhumati asks Shyam for his horoscope. While Arnav finds Khushi in the trunk of his car, Nani scolds Lavanya for trying to use holy water to wash her face. Meanwhile, Arnav's vehicle breaks down on the way to Nainital. He is annoyed when Khushi keeps talking throughout the way.

episodesList.title: Khushi Has a Fall
episodesList.summary: Shashi shows Shyam his driving licence and asks about the confusion over his date of birth. Khushi falls into a pit and Arnav finds her. Meanwhile, Manorama is shocked when she sees Akash lifting Payal. Later, Khushi's clothes are stolen and she gets stuck in the washroom.

episodesList.title: Payal Rejects Akash's Calls
episodesList.summary: Arnav and Khushi stop at a dhaba. Shashi informs the family that Khushi has gone to Nainital with Arnav. Akash calls up Payal to apologise but she rejects his call. Meanwhile, Arnav is irritated with Khushi and leaves her at the dhaba.

episodesList.title: Shashi Exposes Shyam
episodesList.summary: While Shashi exposes Shyam, Khushi convinces Arnav not to leave her. Arnav asks her to leave before the next morning. But he later realises that she has fever. Meanwhile, Manorama talks to Anjali about Akash's interest in Payal. Later, Shashi follows Shyam and finds Anjali with him.

episodesList.title: Arnav Hurts Khushi
episodesList.summary: While Arnav regrets his behaviour towards Khushi, Shashi threatens to expose Shyam in front of his family. When Shashi gets hysterical, Shyam stops him from taking his medicine. Meanwhile, some miscreants stop Khushi and Arnav. Arnav attacks them, but accidentally hurts Khushi.

episodesList.title: Shyam Attempts Murder
episodesList.summary: The doctor tells Shyam that Shashi's condition is critical. Payal informs Anjali about Shashi's condition. On reaching Delhi, Arnav gives Khushi some money and asks her to leave. While Akash is upset as Payal refuses to talk to him, Shyam disrupts Shashi's oxygen supply. Will he survive?

episodesList.title: Shashi Is Paralyzed
episodesList.summary: Anjali tells Arnav about Shashi's health condition. Shyam torments Shashi as he knows that he can't react. Khushi is sad and upset on seeing Shyam's condition. Meanwhile, Anjali tries to console Khushi's family.

episodesList.title: Shyam Wants to Marry Khushi
episodesList.summary: An emotional Khushi sees Arnav and begins to cry. Shyam tricks Madhumati and Garima into believing that Shashi wants him to marry Khushi. He tells them that he is willing to marry Khushi, but will never leave Anjali as he wants to be with both of them.

episodesList.title: Khushi's Reluctance
episodesList.summary: Khushi learns that Arnav has cleared Shashi's hospital bills. Akash apologises to Payal on behalf of Manorama. Later, Madhumati talks to Khushi about her marriage with Shyam.  However, Khushi isn't willing to marry him.

episodesList.title: Akash Tells Anjali About Payal
episodesList.summary: Payal consoles Khushi as she worries about her marriage with Shyam. Akash tells Anjali about his feelings for Payal. Later, Khushi is upset as she fails to buy any silver or gold on Dhanteras. However, Arnav surprises her. How does he make Khushi happy?

episodesList.title: Khushi Refuses to Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: Arnav helps Khushi untangle herself from the light wires. Meanwhile, Madhumati and Garima confirm Khushi’s engagement with Shyam. Later, while giving medicines to Shashi, Khushi tells him that she won’t marry Shyam. But Shyam overhears her conversation.

episodesList.title: Akash Buys a Diya for Payal
