episodesList.summary: Khushi explains the significance of Diwali to Lavanya. She later seeks Arnav’s help to decorate the hall. Meanwhile, Akash gets a ‘diya’ for Payal. Later, Arnav and Khushi fall on the rangoli. Does Payal accept Akash’s gift?

episodesList.title: Khushi Is in Love With Arnav
episodesList.summary: Arnav is mesmerised when he sees Khushi in a saree. Khushi realises that she is in love with Arnav. She imagines herself and Arnav as a couple. Shyam tries to cheer her up by getting sweets and decorating the house. What makes Khushi realise her love for Arnav?

episodesList.title: Khushi Rejects Shyam's Proposal
episodesList.summary: Anjali asks Arnav why he is worried. Khushi makes Nani happy by telling her about her plans to make diyas. While Lavanya asks her to steal mud from Arnav's plants for the diyas, Madhumati is angry on learning that Khushi has rejected Shyam's proposal. What will Madhumati do now?

episodesList.title: Arnav Finds Khushi's Video
episodesList.summary: Khushi steals mud from Arnav’s plants. Instead of getting angry, he allows her to take it and even removes mud from her eyes. Khushi thinks Arnav is practising black magic. Later, Arnav is shocked to see Khushi's video on his laptop. What is the video about?

episodesList.title: Khushi Punishes Herself
episodesList.summary: Khushi apologises to Arnav for trying to spoil his throat and consumes the juice herself. Later, she receives Diwali gifts from Anjali. Meanwhile, Madhumati is emotional thinking about Shashi and requests Khushi to marry Shyam. Will Khushi change her mind?

episodesList.title: Arnav Is Mesmerized
episodesList.summary: Khushi’s family performs Diwali pooja with the Raizada family. Meanwhile, Shyam deliberately falls sick to avoid meeting Khushi. She and Nani are delighted to see Lavanya shout at her friends for making fun of Nani. Will Khushi learn about Shyam’s presence in the house?

episodesList.title: Nani Has a Wish
episodesList.summary: Nani praises Lavanya and tells her that she wishes her to marry Arnav. Khushi is unhappy when she hears this. Later, Khushi sprains her ankle and goes to Anjali’s room. Will she see Shyam in the room?

episodesList.title: Khushi Wants Answers From Arnav
episodesList.summary: Arnav and Khushi are lost in a moment of love. Khushi is curious to know how Arnav has her anklet. She tries to get him to answer all her questions, but fails to do so. Later, Arnav shocks her when he agrees to marry Lavanya in front of the guests. What is the reason behind his decision?

episodesList.title: Khushi Congratulates Arnav
episodesList.summary: Everyone congratulates Arnav. He, however, stops Nani from fixing the marriage date. Later, while dropping Khushi, he brings up the topic of the anklet. Khushi tells him that he and Lavanya make a good pair. Arnav then asks her to step out of the car. Why does Arnav stop Nani from finalising the wedding date?

episodesList.title: Madhumati's Request to Khushi
episodesList.summary: Madhumati welcomes Arnav to her house. Arnav tells Khushi that she doesn’t mean anything to him. Later, Madhumati screams on seeing Khushi and Shyam’s names written on the wall. She requests Khushi to marry Shyam. Will Khushi agree?

episodesList.title: Arnav Thinks About Khushi
episodesList.summary: Madhumati and Garima are happy with Khushi’s decision to marry Shyam. Arnav recalls his past with Khushi and gets disturbed. What is the motive behind Shyam’s decision to marry Khushi?

episodesList.title: Khushi Gets Farewell Gifts
episodesList.summary: Khushi visits the Raizada house on Anjali and Nani’s request. She overhears Arnav getting angry with Anjali for inviting her. Later, Nani, Anjali and Lavanya give farewell gifts to Khushi. But Arnav then asks her to leave the house. Why is Arnav hostile towards Khushi?

episodesList.title: Shashi Gets  the Wrong Medicine
episodesList.summary: Arnav feels guilty for being rude to Khushi. Shyam is angry for the delay in his engagement with Khushi. In a fit of rage, he puts Shashi’s life in danger, giving him the wrong medicine. Why doesn’t Shyam and Khushi’s engagement take place?

episodesList.title: Khushi Is Unhappy
episodesList.summary: Madhumati blames Khushi for Shashi’s condition and asks her to get engaged to Shyam immediately. Left with no choice, Khushi gets engaged to Shyam. He gives her a gift to cheer her up. Later, Anjali asks Shyam about his wedding ring. Will Anjali find out the truth?

plotHtml:
Arnav Singh Raizada is an arrogant and successful business tycoon from Delhi who is haunted by the death of his parents 14 years ago. He crosses paths with Khushi Kumari Gupta, a spirited girl from a humble background in Lucknow. Their worlds collide when Khushi accidentally disrupts one of his fashion events. Arnav mistakes her for a corporate spy and misbehaves with her, and the chaos causes Khushi's sister Payal's wedding to be called off. After another argument between Arnav and Khushi, Arnav releases the tapes of the fashion show to the media, ruining Khushi's reputation. Khushi is harassed on the streets and saved by Shyam Manohar Jha, a seemingly nice man who is married to Arnav's sister Anjali.
Reeling from disgrace and humiliation, Khushi and Payal are sent to Delhi to live with their paternal aunt Madhumati. In Delhi, fate ensures another run-in with Arnav when Khushi damages his car. Determined to repay him, she ends up at the Raizada mansion, Shantivan, to sell sarees. There, she charms Arnav's kind-hearted sister, Anjali and their grandmother, Devyani, who take an instant liking to her. However, her plans are thwarted by Arnav's aunt Manorama, who falsely accuses her of selling torn sarees, costing Khushi her payment.
Meanwhile, Shyam reappears in Khushi's life under the pretense of being single and charms Madhumati, who offers him to stay in their house as a paying-guest. Khushi seeks Shyam's help to find her a job - he gets her a role at Arnav's office, where Khushi ends up being hired as the assistant of Arnav's girlfirend Lavanya. Arnav is furious when he finds out that Khushi is employed in his office and tries to push Khushi out by giving her difficult and uncomfortable tasks, but Khushi, determined and resilient, completes every challenge he throws her way.
One day, Arnav unknowingly sends Khushi to a guesthouse that was near collapsing - although he saves her, Khushi insults him for putting her life in danger and resigns from her job. She declares she's leaving for Lucknow. However, a sign from her beloved Devi Maiyya convinces Khushi to stay back in Delhi and start a sweet shop. Coincidentally, their first big order takes her straight back to the Raizada house for Anjali's anniversary celebrations.
Khushi is later hired by Anjali to groom Arnav's girlfriend, Lavanya, into the ideal daughter-in-law. Constant interactions spark a slow transformation in Arnav. Though he starts out insulting Khushi repeatedly, he finds himself falling for her. Khushi, too, begins to see other sides of him and starts to develop feelings for him.
Meanwhile, Khushi's adoptive father, Shashi, discovers Shyam's secret. To stop Shashi from exposing him, Shyam causes Shashi to suffer a paralyzing stroke and Shashi ends up wheelchair-bound. Shyam uses the opportunity to manipulate Madhumati into fixing his and Khushi's wedding, but Khushi refuses, citing that she never saw Shyam in that light.
Arnav and Khushi's growing closeness culminates during Diwali where they almost kiss, but Arnav, horrified at his loss of control and fearing vulnerability, announces his marriage with Lavanya instead. A heartbroken Khushi agrees to marry Shyam. When Arnav learns of Khushi's engagement, jealousy and anger resurface. Meanwhile, Arnav's cousin, Akash, falls in love with Payal, causing Arnav and Khushi to form a truce - they bring Akash and Payal together and convince their respective families of the match. The wedding preparations begin.
Eventually, Khushi learns the truth about Shyam and ends the engagement. Fearing that the revelation might ruin Payal and Akash's wedding and break Anjali's heart, she stays silent. Arnav, having finally realized that he is cheating Lavanya, breaks things off with her. Arnav's cousin Nandkishore (nicknamed NK) arrives from Sydney and causes some jealousy in Arnav due to his easy friendship with Khushi.
As the wedding rituals progress, Arnav and Khushi grow closer and closer. On the day of Akash and Payal's wedding, Arnav is ready to declare his feelings for Khushi - however, things go horribly wrong when he comes across Shyam forcibly embracing Khushi and declaring his love to her, interpreting it as them having an affair - something which Shyam confirms to Arnav when Arnav confronts him. A heartbroken Arnav tries to tell Anjali the truth - however, on learning that Anjali is pregnant, he changes his mind. To protect Anjali, Arnav forces Khushi into a six-month contract marriage, using Akash and Payal's marriage to blackmail her.
Their pretend marriage is fraught with tension and underlying affection. Arnav tries his best to hate her and mistrusts her intentions whereas a heartbroken Khushi struggles to understand his motives. The truth of their marriage is only revealed to Khushi one day when she nearly commits suicide due to a misunderstanding which Arnav clears. Khushi tells Arnav the truth of what happened between her and Shyam, but he refuses to believe her and prepares to attend a conference in London.
When Shyam realizes that Arnav changed his will to exclude him, he orchestrates Arnav's kidnapping to claim the Raizada fortune. Arnav's family assumes he is in London, but Khushi eventually realizes the truth, and, with the help of NK and Manorama, rescues Arnav. Upon returning, Khushi exposes Shyam to the Raizadas - however, he denies all her claims and accuses Khushi of coming onto him. Arnav throws Shyam out of the house and declares that he believes Khushi, which sends Anjali into depression and causes a period of great tension in Shantivan.
Arnav and Anjali's paternal grandmother, Subhadra Devi, arrives, disapproving of Khushi and determined to restore Shyam's position in the family. She reveals to both the families that Arnav and Khushi's wedding was religiously invalid as they had not completed all the necessary rituals; Arnav decides to marry Khushi again with all the proper rituals. Meanwhile, Shyam causes Anjali to suffer a miscarriage, and her dwindling health leads Khushi to bring Shyam back into Shantivan for her recovery.
On the day of Arnav and Khushi's wedding, Subhadra Devi tries to sabotage it by revealing a painful secret from the past - Khushi's adoptive mother, Garima, had an affair with Arnav's father (though she did not know he was married), which led to the suicide of Arnav's mother and then his father on the day of Anjali's wedding. Arnav, devastated, remembers his mother's words about not hurting the ones you love for mistakes they didn't commit and ultimately chooses love over hate. He arrives at the mandap and marries Khushi, telling everyone that he does not blame Garima and wants to move on from his past.
On their wedding night, Arnav and Khushi discover hidden cameras in their room, planted by Shyam. They uncover more of his misdeeds, including his role in Anjali's miscarriage, and expose him completely. Anjali, finally seeing the truth, throws Shyam out for good.
Just as peace returns, Arnav's ex-girlfriend from college, Sheetal, arrives with a boy named Aarav, pretending he is Arnav's son to scam the family. Though she is initially successful in deceiving Khushi, Arnav eventually exposes her plot, and later he and Khushi decide to adopt Aarav, giving him a loving home.
To establish her identity beyond being Arnav's wife, Khushi enters a beauty pageant, which she wins with support from Arnav and the family. The couple, after enduring so many storms, finally find their happily ever after - together, stronger than ever.
tagline: Arnav Singh Raizada is an arrogant and successful business tycoon from Delhi who is haunted by the death of his parents 14 years ago.

title: Ishaan: Sapno Ko Awaaz De
summary: Ishaan: Sapno Ko Awaaz De is an Indian musical teen sitcom created by Red Chillies Idiot Box which aired on Disney Channel India from 15 May 2010 to 27 March 2011. It is a musical teen drama that focuses on a 15-year-old boy named Ishaan and the choices that he makes between music and his friends.
plot: Ishaan wants to be famous. Ishaan has to leave his school because of a fee paying problem and joins the school of which he won against the 'Karma Yatra' where everyone hates him. On the other hand, Kabir is thrown out as the lead singer of their band as he was trying to win the competition by offering bribes to the judges, and Ishaan, after becoming the friend of the band members, becomes the lead singer too. After rejecting the chance to be a solo superstar, Ishaan and his friends try to make it big on their own. The group soon learns that success comes with a price and with strong competition in the form of 'Baby Shasha'—the superstar! When faced with choices that could jeopardize his friendship with others, Ishaan makes the toughest decisions of his life. Ishaan also has a love interest, Shyla (Anisa Butt).

The serial shows the family drama where the protagonist has to overcome unforeseen obstacles and still take care of her family.

title: Iss Jungle Se Mujhe Bachao
summary: Iss Jungle Se Mujhe Bachao (transl. Save me from this Jungle) premiered on 13 July 2009 on Sony TV. It was the first and only Indian series based on British reality game show I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here!. The winner of the show was Mona Wasu, who earned prize money of one crore rupees.

articleSections.title: Concept
articleSections.text:
The show is licensed from ITV's format, I'm a Celebrity...Get Me out of Here!. The basic concept is the same, where a group of celebrities have to survive in a jungle camp without any amenities, and must compete with each other to stay on in the show.
Every contestant gets a handful of rice and some soybean or lentils for food every three days, which is clearly not enough for survival. Therefore, they must participate in various physically challenging contests and win "food credits" for themselves and their team members. Each day, the team must nominate one participant to play in the day's contest and be the bread-winner for that day.
At the end of every week, the contestant with the fewest public votes and the contestant with the most elimination nominations from the participants face off in an elimination task called the "Maha Jungle Challenge". The winner of this challenge gets to stay back while the loser is eliminated from the game.
The audience can vote for their favorite participants via phone calls or SMS.

articleSections.title: Celebrities
articleSections.text:
Some more celebrities were introduced in later episodes as the original celebrities started getting eliminated.
The 10 original contestants were: *Mona Wasu (winner) – Indian television actress. *Chetan Hansraj (1st runner up) – Indian television actor. *Anaida (2nd runner up) – 90's Pop icon *Akashdeep Saigal – Indian Television actor. *Aman Verma – Indian film and television actor *Marc Robinson – Fashion director and grooming expert *Shweta Tiwari (Quit) – Television actress and reality TV star *Ishq Bector – Singer *Palak Johal – Roadies fame *Fiza Mohammad – Former wife of politician Chander Mohan.
The 5 wildcards were: *Negar Khan – Model *Jay Bhanushali – Indian television and film actor *Mika Singh – Popular singer *Chitrashi Rawat – Indian actress *Kashmera Shah – Film actress

title: India's Got Talent
summary: India's Got Talent is a televised Indian Hindi language talent show series and is part of the Got Talent franchise. The program is produced and distributed by Fremantle and Syco Entertainment. The show aired on Colors TV until season 8. Since season 9 the show is airing on Sony Entertainment Television.

articleSections.title: Auditions
articleSections.text:
Each year's competition begins with a set of audition stages, the first being the "Producers' Auditions", is conducted across various cities in the India. This stage is open to all forms of acts and judged by an independent group, and thus determines who will take part in the next stage of auditions titled "Judges' Auditions". These are held in Mumbai in studios.
Film City, Mumbai (season 1–8) * Yash Raj Studios, Mumbai (season 9) * Filmistan Studio, Goregaon, Mumbai (season 10-)
Each participant reaching this stage of auditions is held offstage from the main performing area in a waiting room, and given a number that denotes when they will perform. Upon being called before the judges, the participant is given 2–3 minutes to demonstrate their act, with a live audience present for all performances. Each judge is given a buzzer, and may use it during a performance if they are unimpressed, dislike what is being performed, or feel the act is a waste of their time. If a participant is buzzed by all judges, their performance is automatically over. At the end of a performance, the judges give constructive criticism and feedback about what they saw, whereupon they are each given a vote. A participant requires a majority vote approving their performance to proceed to the next stage, otherwise they are eliminated from the program at that stage. Many acts that move on may be cut or forfeit their place, due to the limited slots available for the next stage. Filming for each season begins when the Judges' Auditions are taking place, with the show's host standing in the wings of each venue's stage to interview, and give personal commentary on a participant's performance.
From ninth season onwards, acts who did not attend live auditions could instead submit a taped audition online via SonyLIV.
In the fifth season, the show added a new format to the auditions in the form of the "Golden Buzzer", which began to make appearances within the Got Talent franchise, since it was first introduced on Germany's Got Talent. During auditions, each judge is allowed to use the Golden Buzzer to send an act automatically into the semi-finals, regardless of the opinion of the other judges. Number of golden buzzer usage per judge varies each season, mostly two. In season 8, the host duo were allowed to use the golden buzzer separately and in season 10 the host could press it again.

articleSections.title: Second Round
articleSections.text:
After auditions are completed, the judges conduct a special session (or second "audition" round) to determine which participants will secure a place in the semi-finals of the competition, though the format for this stage has been change several times over the course of the program's history.
Between the first and fifth season, the format was changed to match that used in Britain's Got Talent. Participants who made it through the preliminary auditions had their audition footage reviewed by the judges, who set each one into a specific group, and were not required to perform again (unless the judges requested this). Acts which they liked would be allocated spaces in the semi/quarter finals, with the remainder eliminated from that season's competition. All acts were brought back to learn of the results of the judges' deliberations.
Between sixth and eight season, the format was changed and it was different from any Got Talent franchise. Second round was divided into two parts- 'Hunar War' and 'Spotlight'. The participants were divided into groups according to genre of their acts and judges can choose on the basis of second performance whether they will advance or not.
From season nine onwards, the format was again matched to as of Britain's Got Talent and America's Got Talent.

articleSections.title: Semi-finals and Quarter-finals
articleSections.text:
Between first and third season, participants who pass their auditions and secure a place in the live quarter-finals of the competitions, are divided into groups and compete against each other to secure a place within the live final of the competition. Live episodes of the competition are held within a set venue (the location has varied). The results were announced the next day of the performance episode.
From season four onwards, pre-recorded and edited episodes were telecast where they compete in the semi-final. The results were either announced on the next semi final or on the pre-finale with one performer advancing from public votes and one or two performers advancing from judges' choice. The judges can still use their buzzers to terminate an act.
From season nine onwards when the telecasting network was changed from Colors to SET, the show's format after auditions was reimagined and reworked on. Only 14 contestants, including golden buzzer acts advance to quarter-finals to compete in a weekly competition. All the contestants from in a quarter-final. The results of a quarter-final are announced in the next quarter-final after all the performances. The bottom-most contestants from public votes and judge's scores (not revealed) are called upon, and judges can save two of them (number may vary). The final Top-7 move on to the grand-finale which is also pre-recorded.
India's Got Talent becomes first in the Got Talent franchise to have a complete different format and the usage of golden buzzer in quarter-finals to highly appreciate an act.

articleSections.title: Season 1 (2009)
articleSections.text:
Season 1 was hosted by Nikhil Chinapa and Ayushmann Khurrana and the special segment called "India's Got More Talent" was hosted by Roshni Chopra. The show was judged by Sonali Bendre, Kirron Kher and Shekhar Kapur.
The winning act of the first season was the Prince Dance Group from Berhampur, Orissa. The group of 56 people performed a dance inspired by the Lord Vishnu's Dashavatara.

articleSections.title: Season 2 (2010)
articleSections.text:
, season 2 winner Season 2 was hosted by the same duo, Nikhil Chinapa and Ayushmann Khurrana, as they were selected through voting by the judges and the viewers.
Sonali Bendre and Kirron Kher continued their roles as judges, however Shekher Kapur was replaced by Sajid Khan.
The winners of season 2 were the Shillong Chamber Choir, led by Neil Nongkynrih from Shillong, Meghalaya.

articleSections.title: Season 3 (2011)
articleSections.text:
Season 3 was hosted by singer Meiyang Chang and actor-model Gautam Rode. The judges of this season were Sonali Bendre, Kirron Kher and Dharmendra.
The second runner-up of season 2, SNV Group (named after members Suresh Mukund and Vernon Monteiro), emerged as the winner of the season.

articleSections.title: Season 4 (2012)
articleSections.text:
, season 4 winner Season 4 was hosted by Manish Paul and Cyrus Sahukar. Kirron Kher, Malaika Arora Khan, and Karan Johar were judges. Farah Khan later replaced Malaika Arora Khan.
Dancers Sonali Majumdar and Maraju Sumanth, who formed the duo Bad Salsa from Kolkata's Bivash Dance Academy, were crowned winners of the fourth season.

articleSections.title: Season 5 (2014)
articleSections.text: Season 5 was hosted by Mantra and Bharti Singh. Later, Mantra was replaced by VJ Andy. Malaika Arora Khan, Kirron Kher and Karan Johar reprised their roles as judges. Ragini Makkhar's Naadyog Academy won the season. Indore, Madhya Pradesh-based Ragini Makkhar's Naadyog Academy is a 25-year-old dance institution which consists of 360 students.

articleSections.title: Season 6 (2015)
articleSections.text: Season 6 was hosted by Bharti Singh, Nakuul Mehta and Sidharth Shukla. Malaika Arora Khan, Kirron Kher and Karan Johar reprised their roles as judges. Aerial dancer Manik Paul won the season winning a cash prize of ₹50,00,000.

articleSections.title: Season 7 (2016)
articleSections.text: Season 7 was hosted by Bharti Singh and Sidharth Shukla. Malaika Arora Khan, Kirron Kher and Karan Johar reprised their roles as judges. Flautist Suleiman, a 13-year-old flute player from Amritsar, Punjab won the season, and dance duo Papai and Antara bagged the runner-up positions.

articleSections.title: Season 8 (2018)
articleSections.text: Season 8 was hosted by Bharti Singh and Rithvik Dhanjani. Malaika Arora Khan, Kirron Kher and Karan Johar reprised their roles as judges. 27-year-old close-up magician Javed Khan had a tie with Live 100 Experience Band in the final stage, but with more votes coming his way, he was awarded the trophy and prize money of Rs 25 lakh.

articleSections.title: Season 9 (2022)
articleSections.text: Season 9 was hosted by Arjun Bijlani. Kirron Kher continue serving as judge for the ninth season along with Shilpa Shetty Kundra, Baadshah and Manoj Muntashir. The format of the show was changed. Flute & beat box duo Divyansh & Manuraj won the season, whereas Ishita Vishwakarma and Bomb Fire Crew finished as runner-up and 2nd runner-up, respectively.

articleSections.title: Season 10 (2023)
articleSections.text:
Auditions were held in various cities in May and June 2023.
Season 10 aired from 29 July 2023. It was again hosted by Arjun Bijlani and Kirron Kher, Badshah and Shilpa Shetty returned as judges. According to some reports Manoj Muntashir was dropped owing to film Adipurush's dialogues controversy but the makers said, "Given Kirron Kher's health issues last season, they had four judges as a safety option. However, this time it's just the trio that will take on the panel."
Abujmarh Mallakhamb and Sports Academy emerged as the winner of this season winning ₹ 20,00,000. Raaga Fusion and Golden Girls as 1st and 2nd runners-up respectively winning ₹ 5,00,000 each.

articleSections.title: Season 11 (2025)
articleSections.text:
Auditions were held in various cities in July and August 2025.
Season 11 started airing from 4 October 2025. It was again hosted by Haarsh Limbachiyaa with Navjot Singh Sidhu, Malaika Arora and Shaan as judges. Given Kirron Kher's health issues, she was dropped from the judging panel after judging the show since its inception.

articleSections.title: ''India's Got More Talent''
articleSections.text: India's Got More Talent was a companion show broadcast on channel Colors, after the main India's Got Talent broadcast for season one. It featured behind-the-scenes footage of India's Got Talent and showed the emotional responses of the contestants after the judges comment on their performances. It was presented by Roshni Chopra.

episodesList.title: Season six begins
episodesList.summary: 'India's got talent' proves to be the best platform in giving talent a boost as it kick starts its sixth season. The first episode has aerial acts and aqua acts.

episodesList.title: WOAH! Karan got a lap dance!
episodesList.summary: Akshay Kumar continues with his underwater act. Karan Johar gets a lap dance, mentalist's tricks, Chinese opera act and street rap is what this episode has in store.

episodesList.title: Awesomeness inside Circus
episodesList.summary: The stage is set in a circus and the three judges witness stunts and performances which seem to be dangerous, beautiful and heart stopping.

episodesList.title: Have you ever heard of 'Flute-Boxing'?
episodesList.summary: Opening with an international act and ending with a first time ever flute-boxing on India's got talent, this episode promises wonderful entertainment.

episodesList.title: Karan Johar's #GharWapsi on India's Got Talent
episodesList.summary: Karan Johar seems to be missing, but the talent doesn't stop from flowing on India's got talent's stage. As he joins back, he brings along a wave of fresh talent.

episodesList.title: Witness a beautiful Bacchon ki Qawwali
episodesList.summary: Zombie dance, Qawwali by children and a dance on the theme of Krishna and many other performances make this episode a must watch.

episodesList.title: Stage is set for 'Bombay Velvet'
episodesList.summary: Amongst the high level performances of woo doo doll and gymnastics, Karan Johar along with Ranbir Kapoor and Anushka Sharma promote their film 'Bombay Velvet'.

episodesList.title: Anushka Sharma volunteers for a powerpacked act
episodesList.summary: Judges and guests volunteer in an act. Anushka Sharma stands for an animal that was a part of the act. A lot of performances surprise both the judges and the guests.

episodesList.title: Celebrities got weird talent
episodesList.summary: Famous television celebrities showcase their hidden talent which ranges from singing to magic. The judges are in for a surprise in this celebrity episode.

episodesList.title: Goosebumps Guaranteed!
episodesList.summary: There are some honest performances which turn out to be funny and then there are performances which give us goose bumps.

episodesList.title: Have a look at Malaika's doppelganger
episodesList.summary: The episode kick starts with a dance performance by Malaika's doppelganger, an escape artist and a mime act which scares Kiron Kher.

episodesList.title: Mime artist scares Kirron Kher
episodesList.summary: The episode kick starts with a dance performance by Malaika's doppelganger, an escape artist and a mime act which scares Kiron Kher.

episodesList.title: Karo ya maro in the 'Knock Out' round
episodesList.summary: The selected candidates have advanced to the 'Knock Out' round where they will be competing against each other to make their way to the semi-finals.

episodesList.title: Its 'Knock Out' round on India's Got Talent
episodesList.summary: The 'Knock Out' round is still on and the participants are giving their best to lure the judges. There is pure versatility on display as participants go head to head.

episodesList.title: Twisted Semi-final
episodesList.summary: 1st Semi-final with a twist! The two contestants who perform best will directly go for the pre-finale, one chosen by the judges and the other through an audience poll. The Judges vote for X1X juniors!

episodesList.title: Lokendra pal enters Pre-finale
episodesList.summary: Its the 2nd round of the semi-finals and eight contestants are performing. The judges pick Lokendra Pal to enter the pre-finale and the other selection depends upon the audience poll.

episodesList.title: The ABCD of talent!
episodesList.summary: It's the 3rd semi-final round! Remo D'Souza and Varun Dhawan have come for the promotion of ABCD 2. The judges change the rules a bit and select Warrior Dance Crew and Manik Paul for the pre-finale.

episodesList.title: Jogeshwari wins
episodesList.summary: The 4th semi-final round is here! With their extraordinary performances, participants win the hearts of the judges and Jogeshwari is selected using the judge's choice for the pre-finale.

episodesList.title: First Three finalists of IGT 6!
episodesList.summary: Nine pre-finalists are chosen to compete with the six challengers from IGT 5. Yogeshwari Mistry, Prahlad Acharya and X1X group are the first three finalists of IGT 6!

episodesList.title: Who are the FINAL 6 OF IGT 6?
episodesList.summary: The pre-finale round 2 is here. Harmanpreet & Parry G, Manik Paul and Beat Breakers are announced as the next three finalists of IGT 6. The final six contestants will face the toughest challenge.

episodesList.title: Grand finale Season 6
episodesList.summary: And the Grand Finale is finally here! Anupam Kher is tonight's guest on the show. The one who wins IGT Season 6 is none other than Manik Paul!

episodesList.title: Start with a bang
episodesList.summary: The brand new season of India's Got Talent brings more marvelous performers who leave the judges speechless. Later, Bharthi romances with the shy Tiger Shroff, who arrives with Shraddha Kapoor to promote their film Baaghi.

episodesList.title: Wheeling one's way to fame and glory
episodesList.summary: Despite all adversities, Malkit comes to the show and allures everyone with his amazing German wheel performance. The Judges are also amazed by the other performances including an unique Qawwali by Tina and Rishab's extraordinary dance form.

episodesList.title: Entertainment Galore!
episodesList.summary: Enthralled by a spectacular performance by the Acro Kings. Raj's animated popping skills, the mentalist Abhishek's tricks and little Parth's fiery performance flabbergast the judges. Fun acts like the unique ostrich dance is guaranteed to keep you entertained.

episodesList.title: Enthralling Show of Talent
episodesList.summary: A dinosaur appears on set and terrifies the unsuspecting judges. Aditya, a tiny contortionist mesmerizes the judges with his rubber like spine. Special guest, Emraan Hashmi, and the judges are spellbound by Akash and Adharv's contemporary dance performance.

episodesList.title: Youngest contestant of India's Got Talent
episodesList.summary: The beautiful Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Randeep Hooda make an appearance to promote their upcoming movie 'Sarabjit'. Among multiple performances, the youngest contestant in the show, steals the judges' hearts with her spectacular archery performance.

episodesList.title: The perfect storm of Talent
episodesList.summary: India's Got Talent shoots on ice, where the contestants display their spectacular skating and dancing skills. Anna, an Ukrainian performer wows the judges with her rather unique talent. The other talents follow suit, setting the stage on fire.

episodesList.title: Mesmerizing talents unleashed
episodesList.summary: The judges are charmed by some serene contemporary dancing while their minds explode when a magician baffles them with his spectacular card tricks. Later, a mother and daughter's soulful song strikes an emotional chord with all the judges.

episodesList.title: Extraordinary display of talent
episodesList.summary: Two kids, Indrajit and Ritik perform a death defying hanging Malkhamb and the judges are swept away with their skills and incredible composure. Little Pari's energetic dance performance and Sandra's sensuous voice take the episode to a whole new level.

episodesList.title: Hunarpur ke Hunarbaaz
episodesList.summary: The judges make a bhangra style entrance in the new set at Hunarpur where they are greeted by the marks women of Baghpat. Then, they meet the Jugaad men of Rawal Academy and a couple of other groups. However, which groups qualify remains to be seen.

episodesList.title: Ticket to Semi-Finals
episodesList.summary: The contestants have a new challenge. If they can impress the judges enough with their performance, they will earn a direct seat into the semi-finals. The stage is set. The bar is high. Who will rise to the challenge?

episodesList.title: Bollywood sets the show rolling
episodesList.summary: Watch India shine as Sheetal Mahajan, a professional skydiver hoist the India's Got Talent flag, thousands of feet above the ground. Later, Akshay Kumar, Jacqueline Fernandez, Riteish Deshmukh and Abhishek Bachchan promote their movie Housefull 3.

episodesList.title: Parineeti's sparkling presence
episodesList.summary: With Parineeti Chopra on the show and Karan Johar dressed in a leather jacket, there's no shortage of style and glamour. Later, flames will threaten the acrobatic artists as they perform miraculous feats and push themselves to the limits.

episodesList.title: Sulaiman captures everyone's hearts
episodesList.summary: The judges are treated to a series of breathtaking performances of song and dance. Later, young Sulaiman outdoes everyone with his masterful skill at playing the flute.

episodesList.title: A glorious journey
episodesList.summary: Be amazed by performances that vary from dancing to 'kawali' to a choir from Nagaland. Be a part of the journey that began with the auditions and is still going strong.

episodesList.title: Survival of the most talented
episodesList.summary: Amazing talent, breath-taking performances and tears - that is what one gets in this special face-off episode. From 'Qawwali' to 'Rock and Roll' and an inspiring shadow act, who will survive and march forward? Also watch Kirron and Malaika groove to the beats of a band on stage.

episodesList.title: Ticket to the semis with the 'Golden Freeze'
episodesList.summary: With the 'Golden Freeze' introduced, the contestants now have a chance to seal their place in the semi-finals. With scintillating dances, sultry singing, daredevil acts, and stand up comedy, who will linger in the spotlight?

episodesList.title: Spellbinding performances to reach the finals
episodesList.summary: It's time to select the last 3 finalists. One team will be chosen by the judges and qualify for the finals directly. The other 2 teams will be selected by the viewers' votes. With brilliant acts from all the teams, which one will the judges select?

episodesList.title: Maa tujhe salaam!
episodesList.summary: A soulful song sung by Rajeev, helps lift up the spirit of the audience. Later, a patriotic themed dance by the 'Rock On Crew' group, leads to a standing ovation from the judges and the crowd. With great performances lined up, this stage is on fire!

episodesList.title: A blind romance
episodesList.summary: Karan entertains us with his special karaoke performance. Exceptionally talented performers present a blindfold dance which leaves everyone in awe. Later, the finalists are announced, although, the judges have a surprise up their sleeve.

episodesList.title: The Sultan leaves his mark
episodesList.summary: Salman Khan and Anushka Sharma grace the stage and marvel at the fantastic skills that the finalists have to offer. Who will be top in a nail-biting contest? From daring 'Mallakhamba' moves to dazzling instrumentalists, this episode has it all.

episodesList.title: IGT - Season 7 Grand Finale
episodesList.summary: Graced by Anil Kapoor's presence, the grand finale sees the top five contestants perform mind boggling acts leaving the judges and guests, John Abraham, Varun Dhawan and Jacqueline Fernandez, in awe. Whose talent will claim the season 7 grand title?

episodesList.title: A grand opening!
episodesList.summary: India's Got Talent is back with their latest season and this time it promises to be bigger and better. Things kick off on the right note as Arjun Kapoor and Parineeti Chopra join the glamorous panel of judges in the very first episode.

episodesList.title: Swag of Rajasthan!
episodesList.summary: The Desi band Swagsthan create an electrifying atmosphere with their sensational fusion of Rajasthani folk music with rock and rap. The other performances include a daredevil stunt by Gunjan and an acrobatic spectacle by Rahul-Mukesh.

episodesList.title: Almaz goes airborne!
episodesList.summary: The performances are getting bigger and better as the judges are rendered speechless by young aerial artist, Almaz Khan. Catch all the fun from this segment including a musical performance by Swaranjali Music Academy.

episodesList.title: Malaika's Live 100 experience
episodesList.summary: This week's unlimited dose of fun and entertainment starts with an astounding act of Malkhamb. But things become really exciting when the musical group, Live 100 Experience performs which even inspire Malaika Arora to join them.

episodesList.title: Mr. Indian Hacker's experimental act
episodesList.summary: The judges are in for a surprising night as Mr. Indian Hacker comes up with a highly volatile performance. Things get really interesting as Malaika Arora and Rithvik Dhanjani take part in his fun science experiment.

episodesList.title: A daring trapeze act!
episodesList.summary: The judges are in for a nail-biting session as Pramod Patel and Jugal Nachnani perform a dangerous trapeze act. What's so daring? They deliver the amazing aerial stunts above a bed filled with spikes!

episodesList.title: Jamuna circus stuns the judges
episodesList.summary: As the beautiful and talented girls of Jamuna circus take the stage, the judges and audience watch in awe. All the three judges get impressed by their difficult formations and give them a big yes!

episodesList.title: Epic! A car seesaw!
episodesList.summary: Two stuntmen, Rahees and Zeshan, pull off the most dangerous stunt of the season, a car seesaw. But the entertainment doesn't end there as Bidhisha Mohantha impresses the judges with her soulful singing.

episodesList.title: Off goes the golden buzzer!
episodesList.summary: A soft spoken Rammy Singh blows away the judges with his unmatched talent in dancing. When a talent like that is presented in its full glory, the golden buzzer is meant to go off, giving Rammy a golden chance! Catch all the powerhouse performances in this latest episode of India's Got Talent.

episodesList.title: Golden Buzzer for a golden heart
episodesList.summary: Circus is a fading art form but struggling and humble circus performer R G Rathore gets to the stage with one intention - Help the Nation recognise the value of this art. His magnificent stunts on the tightrope leave the judges with no choice but to give him the ultimate prize - The Golden Buzzer!

episodesList.title: When tradition meets Jazz
episodesList.summary: Jazz may have its roots in a different land, but Anjali who headlines the band Punch has made it her own. Anjali isn't the traditional jazz musician, but she brings something much more unique which leaves everyone mesmerized.

episodesList.title: Mentalist bewitches Malaika
episodesList.summary: Mentalism is an art form which only a few manage to master. One such mentalist arrives on the grand stage of India's Got Talent and captivates everyone as he bewitches judge Malaika Arora.

episodesList.title: Straight to the Semis!
episodesList.summary: Crazy Hoppers, the dance group from Agra blow everyone's mind as they set the bar with their awe-inspiring performace. So brilliant is their performance that the judges give them a ticket straight to the semi-finals.

episodesList.title: Fight for a spot in the semi-finale
episodesList.summary: With an impressive gamut of talent from all the nooks and corners of India, the judges have a hard time selecting the artists for the semi-finale! From powerful singles to majestic groups, everyone gets a chance to prove their worth and go through the tough ordeal of selection and rejection. Watch the pinnacle of artistry to know who climbs the ladder of success in the latest episode of India's Got Talent.

episodesList.title: Sara-Sushant steal the show
episodesList.summary: The competition for the three precious spotlights is on as the contestants deliver their best to seal their spots at the semi-finals. But it's the glamorous duo of Sushant Singh Rajput and Sara Ali Khan that grabs the real spotlight as the guest judges.

episodesList.title: Riteish-Saiyami light up the semis
episodesList.summary: It's not just any semi-finals, it's a star-studded semi-final! With the lead actors of the upcoming flick Mauli, Riteish Deshmukh and Saiyami Kher making a fabulous entry, the crowd goes wild and the contestants get ready for their decisive performances. From enjoying to the fullest to getting inspired from the contestants, Riteish and Saiyami raise the level of fun and entertainment!

episodesList.title: Katrina-Anushka at the Semi-Finale!
episodesList.summary: From SST Warning Crew bringing Disneyland to the stage, to Altmas wowing the judges with her mesmerising performance, the road to finale is one that will put you at the edge of your seat! Watch as Katrina Kaif and Anushka Sharma join the semi-final stage and shake a leg in this episode.

episodesList.title: Proneeta Vs Kirron: The Twerk debate
episodesList.summary: The Semi finale is on at full throttle as the contestants deliver the performances of their lives in hopes of sealing a spot at the finale. But this contest is not without a bit of tension, exemplified by judge Kirron Kher's conflict with Proneeta Swargyari regarding her twerking. Will the judge's objection cost Proneeta a spot in the finals?

episodesList.title: Last Semi with Vicky and Yami!
episodesList.summary: It's the last semi-finale of the season and Vicky Kaushal and Yami Gautam, lead actors of the upcoming flick Uri, are here to cheer the contestants one last time before they give it their all to get one step closer to making history. Watch this glorious episode and catch Vicky and Yami go awestruck with the talent unleashed royally on stage.

episodesList.title: A Sufi tribute to married man Ranveer
episodesList.summary: The hunt for the top 5 has begun with the pre finale contest. Hold on to your seats because some extra special guests have joined the judges' panel for this extra special contest. They are none other than the cast of Simmba! title: India Calling
summary:
India Calling is an Indian television series that aired on Star One from 14 November 2005 to 5 October 2006. It stars Manasi Parekh, Pankit Thakker and Vipul Gupta in lead roles. The series is about a Punjabi girl named Chandni who worked in an international call centre.
Audience research conducted by Star One suggested that viewers "didn't like the idea of a heroine who 'talked back'". Although India Calling was flopped in the ratings and was canceled after one season, the show made Manasi Parekh a household name in India.
plot: Chandni is the middle class girl living in Jalandhar who adores her elder sister, Mini Didi / Manisha Kapoor. Manisha is working in Mumbai as a call centre executive. Due to Manisha's absence on her engagement, Chandni gets engaged with Dilawar. But before marriage, she decides to go to Mumbai, to experience the famed city life, and meet her Mini Didi. But, being unable to find Manisha, she decides to take up the job at the call center, India calling, in her sister's search. Meanwhile after an initial hate relationship, she fall in love with Aditya , the owner of the call center. She is unaccustomed to the nonstop pace of city life. The show follows Chandni's struggles in life while working in a call center and trying to find her sister, Mini Didi / Manisha Kapoor.

title: Instant Khichdi
summary: Instant Khichdi is an Indian sitcom that aired on STAR One from 1 July 2005 to 7 August 2005. The series served as the second season of Khichdi franchise and a sequel to the show Khichdi, which aired on STAR Plus channel. The show has been made into a film: Khichdi: The Movie.
plot:
The series portrays the life of an eccentric Gujarati joint family living in Mumbai. The family is led by the elderly Tulsidas Parekh and consists of his offspring, who he acquired at a local carnival. The first season, particularly the initial episodes, focus on the idiosyncratic members of the family who are only united by their desire to separate from each other. Since the patriarch does not permit them to sell off their house and separate into nuclear families, they live on hoping that he changes his mind or passes away. Eventually, they move into a much larger house left behind by a deceased aunt.
They become overnight millionaires when they discover oil in their older property. The second season portrays humorous depictions of a bourgeois family that is trying to settle itself into higher society with their new-found wealth. They live on in their own eccentric way, trying to ace the lives of the super-rich.

plotHtml:
The series portrays the life of an eccentric Gujarati joint family living in Mumbai. The family is led by the elderly Tulsidas Parekh and consists of his offspring, who he acquired at a local carnival. The first season, particularly the initial episodes, focus on the idiosyncratic members of the family who are only united by their desire to separate from each other. Since the patriarch does not permit them to sell off their house and separate into nuclear families, they live on hoping that he changes his mind or passes away. Eventually, they move into a much larger house left behind by a deceased aunt.
They become overnight millionaires when they discover oil in their older property. The second season portrays humorous depictions of a bourgeois family that is trying to settle itself into higher society with their new-found wealth. They live on in their own eccentric way, trying to ace the lives of the super-rich.
tagline: The series portrays the life of an eccentric Gujarati joint family living in Mumbai.

title: Indian Idol
summary:
Indian Idol is an Indian Hindi-language singing reality competition on Sony TV. It is an Indian version of the British show Pop Idol  and is part of the Indian Idol series. It has aired on Sony Entertainment Television since 2004.  Originally produced by Miditech Studios and its iconic producer-brothers, Niret Alva, Nikhil J Alva and Nivedith Alva, the series was an instant success. The brothers produced the first 5 seasons of the series and were instrumental in laying the foundation for its future success.
Indian Idol's production and taping take place in Mumbai, Maharashtra. It broadcasts on Saturdays and Sundays and digitally airs on SonyLIV application.

title: Indradhanush
summary:
Indradhanush (English: Rainbow) is  an Indian children's television series that aired on DD National channel. The series  was produced and directed by Anand Mahendroo. It also featured several young actors like Karan Johar, Urmila Matondkar, Vishal Singh, Ashutosh Gowarikar, and Akshay Anand.
The show used tracks from Maurice Jarre's score for A Passage to India.
plot: The shows follows the story of a group of kids, who assemble a computer. The computer becomes the host to an alien prince from a planet in the Andromeda Galaxy on the run from his enemies. The following events take a lot of weird turns leading to one of the friends, Appu, getting kidnapped by one of the enemies of the Prince. The Prince gives the friends a time-travel machine. With this machine they travel to the past and future (1942 and 2013) to rescue their friend.
reception: The show was an instant hit and kept viewers hooked because of its fresh content. It is still considered an important show in the history of Indian television.

episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: Appu and his friends attempt to build a computer by assembling parts taken from his house.

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Appu and gang succeed in making a working computer, but in the night, unbeknownst to them, an alien being enters the computer.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: Appu feeds the information to the computer about the world, but he and his friends are shocked when the computer starts talking to them.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: Appu's family is celebrating his birthday, but Appu is missing again from the home. Appu takes his friend, Preeti, to show his computer when she makes fun of him when she doesn't believe in his invention. Preeti asks computer about Quit India movement and the computer and suddenly they disappear out of the sight.

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: Searching for Appu, Bala and Srikant reach godown and Bala finds out about the computer. The computer tells them it has transported Appu and Preeti to 1942 because they wanted to know about Quit India movement. Bala and Srikant travel to 1942 and gets injured in a car accident, driven by his own grandmother and meets his grandfather (Ashutosh Gowariker).

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: In 1942, Bala loses the remote given to them by the computer to return to 1989, but is able to recover with help of Preeti, who is separated from Appu. In the present, Appu and Preeti's parents are worried about their disappearance. Meanwhile, an android being lands on the earth, looking for Appu.

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: In 1942, Bala, Srikant and Preeti managed to locate Appu, but he is kidnapped by the android. The computer manages to fight off the android and sends him to Stone Age, but the Android converts Appu into a crystal.

episodesList.title: Episode 8
episodesList.summary: The computer reveals to the gang that it'll need "atomic decoder", which will only be available in 2013, to get Appu back in his body from crystal. Bala time travels to 2013 and realizes that a professor (Vikram Gokhale) has made a clone (also called Bala) from his DNA. He also meets clone's girlfriend, Sunita (Urmila Matondkar).

episodesList.title: Episode 9
episodesList.summary: Bala's presence at clone's house creates a confusion in the house with the professor and Sunita. At first, clone Bala does not believe Bala has indeed time travelled, but ultimately believes him and agrees to share his atomic decoder with him, however somebody has stolen the device.

episodesList.title: Episode 10
episodesList.summary: Bala and Clone Bala use time travel to catch the thief, who is revealed to be the professor's employee, Joseph. Bala takes atomic decoder to present and the computer uses atomic decoder to revive Appu back to his normal body.

episodesList.title: Episode 11
episodesList.summary: The next day, the computer reveals that he's the prince of Andromeda Galaxy and the android was sent from Andromeda to abduct Appu so that his body can be used to revive the usurper, who killed his father. Appu and friends travel to the past with their history teacher, Mr. Sharma, where they are caught by a bandit. The bandit threatens to execute them, but lets them go when they appeal to his conscience. The remote is stolen by Joshua, a student, when they return to the present.

episodesList.title: Episode 12
episodesList.summary: Joshua travels to the past and is caught by a group of cannibals. After apologizing to Appu, the computer allows to use him the remote and return to the present. After Joshua returns, the remote passes through various hands, each meeting an adverse fate.

episodesList.title: Episode 13
episodesList.summary: Bala travels in the past using the android's handheld supercomputer to retrieve the remote, which is stuck in the past. Bala is captured by the king's soldiers in the past. The remote is found by confidantes of a princess Charusheela and they use it to reunite her with her lover, Surendra Singh, but they are captured by enemies. Bala uses the remote to help them evade the enemies, returns to the present and saves Appu from gangsters.

title: Idhar Udhar
summary:
Idhar Udhar is a Hindi sitcom which first aired on Doordarshan in 1985. It was directed by Anand Mahendroo and produced by Shobha Doctor. It starred real-life sisters Ratna Pathak and Supriya Pathak. Its first season was taken off the air after 12 episodes.
The show was heavily inspired by Three's Company.
In December 1997, owing to the success of Dekh Bhai Dekh, Anand Mahendroo launched a sequel to the series under the banner of Advance Entertainment Network Ltd. with the original star cast of both Pathak sisters and Liliput, along with Bhavana Balsavar.

articleSections.title: Season 1 (1985)
articleSections.text:
The story revolves around the lives of Sunita (Ratna Pathak), an air hostess and Poonam (Supriya Pathak), an ad executive. They stay together as paying guests in a flat in Mumbai. Their lives take an interesting turn when they end up sharing their flat with Kumar Bhairav (Ravi Baswani), a struggling actor and Sudhir (M.M. Faruqui (Lilliput)), a small-time broker.
Season 1 focuses on all the problems and joys they experience living in the same house.

articleSections.title: Season 2 (1998)
articleSections.text: 13 years later, Sunita (Ratna Pathak) and Poonam (Supriya Pathak / Lillete Dubey) return to Mumbai and end up sharing the same apartment exactly the way they used to. They are allotted the same apartment by their old friend Sudhir's (Liliput) mischievous adopted sons Jai and Harsh. Sudhir is now a filthy rich builder and married to his ex-secretary Katie (Bhavana Balsavar).
